title: KERING Financial Analyst
description:
**Summary**

KERING Financial Analyst
  
Job Family: Accounting & Consolidation
  
Job Title: Kering Financial Analyst
  
Location: Wayne, NJ
  
  
A global, family-led luxury group, home to people whose passion and expertise nurture creative luxury Houses in couture, ready-to-wear, leather goods, décor, jewelry, eyewear and beauty: Gucci, Saint Laurent, Bottega Veneta, Balenciaga, Alexander McQueen, Brioni, Boucheron, Pomellato, Dodo, Qeelin and Ginori 1735, as well as Kering Eyewear and Kering Beauté. Celebrating their creative heritage, our luxury Houses design and craft exceptional products and experiences that ignite emotion, inspire people and drive positive change through creative luxury.

**Job Description**

***Summary***

*We are looking for a* ***Financial Analyst, FP&A*** *to join our* ***AMER FP&A Team*** *and play an active role in financial controlling, planning, forecasting, and internal control activities across the region’s retail entities.*

*The position will work closely with selected brands supported by the* ***Kering FP&A Team*** *, building strong relationships with key stakeholders and acting as a trusted* ***finance business partner*** *to support financial performance and business decision-making.*

*Beyond core FP&A responsibilities, the Financial Analyst will gain broad exposure across the Americas region and be actively involved in* ***strategic and pilot finance projects*** *, contributing to the continuous improvement and transformation of finance processes.*

*You will join a* ***collaborative, proactive, and close-knit team*** *where knowledge sharing, open communication, and mutual support are part of our daily way of working. We value people who bring ideas, take initiative, and enjoy working together to find solutions and achieve common goals.*

*This role offers a strong combination of* ***financial expertise, business partnering, cross-functional collaboration, and project exposure*** *, providing an excellent opportunity to grow professionally and develop a comprehensive understanding of finance within a dynamic and international environment.*

***HOW YOU WILL CONTRIBUTE***

* Manage month-end closing activities and prepare reporting packages for the Divisional Finance Department
* Support the budgeting and forecasting processes, including data submission, variance analysis, and commentary
* Monitor and control CapEx investments
* Support balance sheet reviews and related variance analysis in collaboration with the Accounting team
* Deliver monthly reporting for retail managers and operational functions (Facilities, Security, HR, Communications etc.) to ensure cost control
* Review accounting data to identify and resolve inaccuracies or discrepancies
* Handle ad hoc financial queries and perform additional analyses as required
* Support the implementation of the Finance Project
* Built us a strong relationship with the Brands managed

***WHO YOU ARE***

* Minimum 2 years of experience in Finance, Accounting, or Controlling within a multinational company or consulting firm

* Master’s degree in Business Administration, Economics, or Finance
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Proven team-working capabilities
* High level of accuracy and attention to detail
* Proficiency in Excel and BI tools for performance and KPI monitoring
* SAP/Esker/HFM knowledge is a plus
* Retail industry experience is a plus
* Fluent in Italian or French or Spanish is a plus
* Availability to work from the NYC offices 2–3 days per month to meet with and support the brands.

**Salary: $80,000 - $90,000 per year plus bonus & incentives**

**Health benefits include:** Medical and prescription drug insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, critical illness insurance, accident insurance, hospital indemnity insurance, personalized healthcare support, wellbeing programs.

**Financial benefits include** : Health Savings Account (HSA), Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs), 401(k) plan, basic life and AD&D insurance, and short-term disability insurance.

Kering is committed to building a diverse workforce. We believe diversity in all its forms – gender, age, nationality, culture, religious beliefs and sexual orientation – enriches the workplace. It opens up opportunities for people to express their talent, both individually and collectively and it helps foster our ability to adapt to a changing world. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we welcome and consider applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of their background.

**Job Type**

Regular

**Start Date**

2026-11-23

**Schedule**

Full time

**Organization**

Kering Americas Inc.

title: Senior Financial Analyst FP&A – Lifestyle Brands
description:
Overview:

Catalyst Brands is seeking a Senior Financial Analyst to support financial planning, forecasting, reporting, and business analysis for our Lifestyle Brands, including Aéropostale, Lucky Brand, and Nautica. This hybrid role is based in Lyndhurst, New Jersey, with three days onsite and two days remote each week.
  
  
The position partners with Finance, Accounting, and Brand business leaders to evaluate performance across retail, e-commerce, and wholesale channels. You will analyze business drivers, explain financial variances, and deliver actionable insights that shape strategic business decisions.  
  
A well-qualified candidate blends proficient financial planning and analysis (FP&A) skills with a corporate accounting foundation, possessing an innate curiosity and ability of translating operational activities into clear financial narratives.

Responsibilities:

**Financial Planning & Analysis:** Drive and support annual budgeting, monthly forecasting, and long-range planning across retail, e-commerce, wholesale, and corporate operations for Aéropostale, Lucky Brand, and Nautica.

**Financial Modeling:** Develop and maintain financial models with clearly documented reasonable assumptions.

**Variance & Performance Analysis:** Analyze sales, gross margin, operating expenses (SG&A), and overall profitability against budget, forecast, and prior periods. Diagnose the underlying root causes of financial variances.

**Accounting & General Ledger Integrity:** Analyze GL accounts and transaction-level details to validate monthly financial results and investigate unexpected variances. Partner closely with Accounting during month-end close to assess accrual needs and resolve discrepancies.

**Commercial Analysis:** Analyze the impacts of pricing strategies, product volume, category mix, and product costs on overall sales and gross margin performance across different brand channels.

**Presentations:** Partner cross-functionally to prepare and present clear financial results, forecasts, and strategic recommendations to senior leadership.

Qualifications:

**Required:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related quantitative field.
* 2 years of relevant experience in FP&A, corporate finance, or a combination of accounting and financial analysis.
* Advanced Excel capabilities (complex formulas, lookups, index/match, pivot tables, and driver-based modeling) with a demonstrated ability to self-audit work.
* Proficient written and verbal communication skills; ability to build cross-functional relationships.

**Preferred:**

* Knowledge of retail and/or wholesale business models, including their unique financial drivers.
* Prior finance or accounting experience within the apparel, footwear, retail, or consumer packaged goods (CPG) sectors.
* Experience with enterprise systems and reporting tools, such as Oracle, OneStream, or MicroStrategy.

**What You Get**

If eligible, we offer a competitive benefits package including medical/dental/vision, term life insurance, paid vacation/holidays\*, and 401(k) with Company match. All associates are eligible for an associate discount on Catalyst Brands merchandise. For paid holidays, associates who are eligible for paid vacation (MTO) are also eligible for eight paid holidays during the calendar year. All store hourly associates scheduled to work on a designated holiday will receive additional compensation. \*For paid vacation days, as well as eligibility requirements for other benefits, please visit www.catalystbrandsbenefits.com

**About Catalyst**

Catalyst Brands reflects the bringing together the rich heritages of our brands with modern excitement and a new vision for success. Five iconic brands came together under a unified powerhouse portfolio to celebrate the essence of American style. We will leverage our rich history, resources and best-in-class industry talent to further build the success of our brands. At Catalyst we are united in one shared purpose: We exist to ignite America’s most beloved retail brands to make fashion accessible to all.

Working at Catalyst means joining a dedicated team of associates who are encouraged to be uniquely themselves in a safe, caring and welcoming environment. It is a place where careers prosper, accomplishments are celebrated and diversity flourishes. It’s a place that’s meant for you.

For more opportunities to join our team please visit our careers page.

title: Senior Tax Analyst, Corporate Tax
description:
Where Conviviality is at work.

Pernod Ricard is a global premium international champagnes and spirits company. We’re the team behind leading brands such as ABSOLUT® Vodka, Jameson® Irish Whiskey, Malibu®, Kahlúa® Liqueur, The Glenlivet®, Beefeater and Malfy Gins, and a leading portfolio of American whiskey brands including Jefferson’s, Rabbit Hole, TX, Smooth Ambler and Skrewball™ whiskey.

Working at Pernod Ricard is all about igniting conviviality in all that we do. Derived from the French word, convivialité…it means human connection, authenticity, friendly, and jovial. Conviviality is energy and spirit with a splash of je ne sais quoi and is a core philosophy around how we live and work at Pernod Ricard.

  

Guided by our 4 core values: (1) grounded in the real; (2) fiercely authentic; (3) passion for challenge; and (4) connected beyond borders; we are team players, dream makers, trailblazers, movers and (cocktail) shakers. We have a passion for living life to the fullest, making new friends every day, and realizing our potential as people and as a business!

The salary range for this role, based in New York, is $91,300.00 to $125,598.00. The range may vary if the role outside of this location. Base salaries are determined during our interview process, by assessing a candidate’s experience, skills against internal peers and against the scope and responsibilities of the position.

**Job Summary:**

Join Pernod Ricard's U.S. Tax team and play a critical role in supporting tax compliance, reporting, and planning activities across a dynamic portfolio of domestic and international entities. Reporting to the Tax Director, this role offers broad exposure to corporate income tax, tax accounting, audits, transfer pricing, and strategic tax initiatives. This is an exciting opportunity for a tax professional who enjoys solving complex challenges, partnering across functions, and contributing to a high-performing finance organization.

**Who will love this job:**

You will thrive in this role if you:

* Enjoy navigating complex tax regulations and translating technical concepts into business insights.
* Have a strong attention to detail and take pride in delivering accurate, high-quality work.
* Are naturally curious and stay informed on evolving tax laws and regulatory developments.
* Enjoy partnering with stakeholders across finance, accounting, FP&A, and international teams.
* Take ownership of your work and can successfully manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Are motivated by continuous learning, process improvement, and finding more efficient ways to work.

**What you’ll do**:

  

* Prepare federal income tax and non-income tax filings.
* Review state and local income tax returns to ensure accuracy and compliance.
* Support quarterly and year-end tax provision processes, including forecast reporting and IFRIC 23 requirements.
* Prepare monthly tax account reconciliations and analyze tax-related balances.
* Respond to notices and inquiries from federal, state, and local taxing authorities.
* Assist with federal and state tax audits and support requests from auditors.
* Manage and monitor tax filing calendars to ensure timely compliance with all filing obligations.
* Conduct tax research and contribute to tax planning initiatives and transfer pricing analyses.
* Partner closely with Finance, Accounting, FP&A, affiliates, and global tax teams on tax-related matters.
* Monitor technical tax developments and assess potential impacts on the business.
* Participate in special projects and continuous improvement initiatives that enhance tax processes and controls.

**What’s in it for me?**

Being part of an inclusive and diverse company where professional development and internal career mobility is front-and-center to our talent strategy. This means your career at Pernod Ricard has many possibilities. You'll be part of a culture that celebrates the rich diversity of our people across the globe and be part of our long-standing commitment to making exceptional products, giving back to our communities, and honoring our responsibility to preserve the environment.

**Required qualifications**:

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Taxation, or a related field.
* CPA designation required.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience within a Big 4 or well-regarded public accounting firm focused on corporate tax compliance and reporting.
* Strong knowledge of U.S. corporate income tax law, state and local taxation, and international tax concepts.
* Experience preparing and reviewing corporate income tax returns and related tax accounting under ASC 740 and/or IAS 12.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, ONESOURCE, and Bloomberg Tax.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex information and deliver actionable insights.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work independently while effectively collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders.
* Continuous improvement mindset with a passion for learning and process enhancement.

2026-12-14

Our values are lived, they drive our behaviors, and it’s what brings our culture to life.

title: Financial Analyst
description:
Is the opportunity to join a culture where “We Do the Right Thing,” and “We Courageously Shape Our Future Together” important to you? If so, Guardian is seeking a motivated individual to join our team as a Financial Analyst.

Reporting to the Head of Planning & Expense Consolidation, this role plays a central position within Group FP&A, supporting consolidated expense planning, reporting, and strategic analytics across the Group Benefits organization.

The Financial Analyst partners closely with Expense Management, Product, Pricing, and senior leadership to deliver actionable insights, enhance expense transparency, and support business decision-making. This role combines executive reporting, operational rigor, and forward-looking analytics to influence financial outcomes.

**You will**

Expense Planning & Leadership Support

* Own consolidated expense exhibits supporting the annual planning process and executive leadership reviews
* Develop clear, executive-ready materials highlighting key drivers, risks, and opportunities
* Partner with Expense Management to validate planning assumptions

Strategic Expense Analytics

* Support enterprise-wide expense studies and benchmarking initiatives
* Provide detailed analytics across product, department, and account dimensions
* Translate complex financial data into actionable insights
* Strategically partner and support transformational initiatives inclusive of business case development

Unit Cost & Performance Metrics

* Own monthly unit cost reporting, validation, and distribution
* Ensure timely and accurate refresh of YTD expense data
* Enhance visibility into cost efficiency and performance trends

Product Allocations

* Own and maintain product allocation methodologies across Group cost centers
* Partner with Pricing and business leaders to support product margin targets
* Resolve allocation variances across Group and Corporate structures

Transformation & Organizational Support

* Support transformation initiatives and organizational changes
* Validate department alignment and assess financial implications
* Identify opportunities to streamline and improve planning processes

Product Strategy Support

* Partner with product teams on profitability and cost analysis
* Provide expense insights tied to allocations and unit cost drivers

Ad Hoc & Cross-Functional Analysis

* Deliver targeted expense analyses for actuarial, regulatory, and leadership needs
* Support cost management, acquisition, and renewal analysis
* Respond to evolving business priorities with strong analytical support

Systems & Controls

* Participate in UAT testing and enhancements for financial systems (e.g., Oracle)
* Ensure integrity, accuracy, and efficiency of expense reporting processes
* Support automation and modernization of FP&A workflows

Technical Skills

* Excel (advanced beginner to intermediate)
* Formulas (SUMIFS, INDEX/MATCH, basic modeling)
* Data manipulation (pivot tables, lookups)
* Familiarity with financial ledger and planning tools.

Ability to:

* Analyze variances (actual vs plan, forecast vs prior)
* Identify key drivers of financial performance
* Translate data into insights

**You have**

Required

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field
* 4+ years of FP&A, financial analysis, or expense management experience
* Strong analytical and financial modeling skills
* Advanced Excel and PowerPoint proficiency
* Ability to synthesize complex data into clear, executive-level insights
* Strong communication and collaboration skills

Preferred

* Experience in insurance or financial services
* Familiarity with Oracle Planning / Hyperion / SmartView
* Experience with large, matrixed organizations

**Location/Travel**

Hybrid: 3 days in a Guardian office located in Hudson Yards, NYC; Holmdel NJ; Boston, MA or Bethlehem, PA

**Salary Range:**

$82,770.00 - $135,975.00

The salary range reflected above is a good faith estimate of base pay for the primary location of the position. The salary for this position ultimately will be determined based on the education, experience, knowledge, and abilities of the successful candidate. In addition to salary, this role may also be eligible for annual, sales, or other incentive compensation.

Open Door Care Network is currently seeking a Staff Accountant for our location in Tarrytown, NY. The Staff Accountant is responsible for maintaining accurate and timely accounting records in accordance with generally accepted accounting standards. This includes but is not limited to managing day-to-day financial transactions, ensuring compliance with restricted fund usage, and maintaining the general ledger. This position reports directly to the Associate Director of Finance and plays an essential role in month-end closes and preparation for annual audits.

annually

opportunities

state, and federal laws

description:
**About Us**
------------

Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.

**About the Company**

Fanatics is expanding into the booming trading cards and collectibles business with a new model and vision for the hobby that will fundamentally change the experience for current and future collectors, leagues, and players across many sports.

With trading cards and collectibles being a significant pillar of Fanatics' long-term plans to become the leading global digital sports platform, Fanatics Collectibles, a subsidiary of Fanatics, was launched in 2021 after securing long-term, exclusive rights to design, manufacture and distribute trading cards for several sports properties, including MLB, MLBPA, NBA, NBPA and NFLPA. Fanatics is the majority owner of Fanatics Collectibles, with leagues, players associations and investors owning the rest.

In January 2022, Fanatics Collectibles announced the acquisition of Topps, the preeminent licensed trading card brand that has serviced collectors, fans, and retailers for more than 70 years. The deal, which included both the Topps physical and digital divisions, established the iconic trading cards company as the cornerstone of Fanatics' trading cards and collectibles business and jumpstarted its MLB and MLBPA rights to design, manufacture and distribute trading cards.

  

**Role Summary:** Fanatics Collectibles is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Manager to join the Royalty Accounting team, reporting directly to the Director of Royalty Accounting team. The Manager – Royalty Accounting Audit & Compliance will lead the coordination and preparation for external partner and licensor audits. This individual will act as the primary liaison for royalty audit requests, ensuring timely and accurate support for licensors. The role will focus heavily on audit preparedness, compliance with licensing agreements, royalty reporting accuracy, internal controls, process improvement initiatives, and supporting the development of end-to-end royalty reporting systems and processes. * Assist with the development and implementation of end-to-end royalty reporting software solutions and process enhancements.
* Partner with IT, Data & Analytics, and Finance Systems teams to improve royalty system integrations, automation, and reporting capabilities.
* Support process mapping, workflow optimization, and testing for new royalty reporting tools and system enhancements.
* Collaborate with Legal, Licensing, FP&A, IT, Operations, and external licensors to address audit inquiries and operational risks.
* Drive continuous process improvements to increase audit efficiency, scalability, and reporting accuracy.

  

**What you will bring...**

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance required; CPA preferred.
* 6+ years of accounting experience with royalty accounting, licensing, audit, or compliance experience.
* Direct experience supporting external royalty audits and licensing compliance reviews.
* Strong understanding of royalty accounting, licensing agreements, accrual accounting, and US GAAP.
* Strong understanding of internal controls and SOX compliance processes.

title: Associate Director, FP&A
description:

Studs connects ear piercing with aftercare and earring shopping to create an end-to-end Earscaping® experience. We offer a better retail and digital experience that prioritizes safety and expertise in a cool, fun and welcoming environment, along with a wide earring assortment—all at an accessible price point.

The Associate Director, FP&A owns financial planning and analysis at Studs, with a focus on improving studio profitability, supporting disciplined expansion, and managing cash. Reporting to the CFO, this person builds and runs the annual budget, rolling forecast, and long-term financial plan directly, translating financial and operational results into clear recommendations. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports at the outset; as the finance team grows, the planning function may report into this role.

This role partners with Retail, Operations, Marketing, Merchandising, and Accounting to connect business decisions to revenue, EBITDA, cash flow, and investment returns. It helps leadership set studio-level performance goals, allocate capital, and identify risks and opportunities early enough to act.

This is a hands-on role for someone who has worked in four-wall retail finance, builds models directly, works through imperfect data, challenges assumptions constructively, and follows through with business partners to improve results.

  

**Salary Range:** $155,000 — $175,000 plus equity

**Location:** HQ (New York, NY) — Hybrid

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

*Financial Planning, Forecasting & Modeling*

* Own the annual budget and rolling forecast process across departments, including timelines, assumptions, and reviews with business leaders.
* Own an integrated P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow forecast; partner with Accounting to assess liquidity, inventory and other working capital needs, and funding requirements.
* Connect studio and e-commerce revenue plans, operating expenses, and capital investments to company profitability and cash targets; identify gaps and recommend adjustments.
* Build scenarios that test growth, profitability, and cash assumptions, making trade-offs and downside risks clear before decisions are made.
* Improve planning tools and processes so forecasts are accurate and assumptions are consistent; use AI, automation, and lightweight software development to streamline recurring work, strengthen reporting, and free up the finance team for higher-value analysis, with appropriate data safeguards and validation.

  

*Performance Analysis & Business Partnership*

* Run regular reviews of company, channel, and studio performance against plan and prior periods, explaining the drivers of results and surfacing risks and opportunities.
* Partner with Retail to set and track studio-level targets for revenue, EBITDA dollars and margin, labor productivity, and utilization; analyze performance by studio and cohort to identify opportunities across the fleet.
* Partner with Marketing and Retail to analyze traffic, conversion, customer acquisition and retention, and marketing returns; recommend investments that connect demand generation to studio capacity and profitable growth.
* Challenge plans constructively, agree on actions and owners with business partners, and track whether those actions improve results.

  

*Strategic Planning & Investment Analysis*

* Build the long-term financial plan and capital allocation analysis, helping leadership prioritize investment across new studios, existing studio improvements, marketing, and other growth initiatives.
* Underwrite new studio investments with Real Estate and Retail, including buildout costs, sales ramp, operating profitability, cash requirements, and payback; compare actual results with the original investment case.
* Evaluate pricing, assortment, new services, and other strategic initiatives; establish financial success measures and compare actual results with expectations.

  

*Reporting & Executive Visibility*

* Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual management reporting, forecasts, and performance analysis for leadership and the board; partner with Accounting, which owns the close and financial statements, to ensure consistent and reliable reporting.
* Support the CFO in communicating the outlook, key risks, and recommended actions to senior stakeholders, and contribute to financing analysis, lender reporting, and fundraising or transaction diligence as needed.

  

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Business, or a related field.
* 6+ years of relevant experience in FP&A or strategic finance, including hands-on ownership of budgeting, forecasting, and long-term financial planning.
* Four-wall retail experience required: prior finance work in a multi-unit retail business with direct responsibility for store or studio-level P&L, labor, and unit economics.
* Strong financial modeling skills, including building integrated financial forecasts and studio-level investment models from scratch and translating results into business recommendations.
* Sound financial judgment, strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and close attention to detail.
* Experience partnering with senior leaders, challenging assumptions constructively, and influencing decisions across teams.
* Clear, direct communicator in writing and in person; comfortable explaining financial performance and recommendations to executive and board audiences.
* Advanced Excel skills and proficiency with financial planning and reporting tools; experience working with ERP, point-of-sale, and operational data to build consistent performance reporting.
* Comfortable building analyses directly, working through imperfect data, and holding business partners accountable for agreed actions; acts with integrity and responds openly to feedback.
* Ability to set priorities in a fast-paced, high-growth environment while staying hands-on and keeping the big picture in view. AI fluency preferred: comfortable using AI tools in daily work and building practical automations, scripts, or internal applications that improve the finance team's speed and effectiveness.

title: FP&A Manager
description:
Bessemer Trust is seeking a Vice President, Manager – Fee Revenue Financial Planning & Analysis, to join the FP&A organization within Finance.

This position will have primary responsibility for the day-to-day management of the firm's fee revenue planning, forecasting, reporting and analysis. The role will develop a deep understanding of the drivers of fee revenue, including client assets, market performance, client flows, pricing, product and service mix, and other underlying business trends, and will translate those drivers into clear financial insight for senior management.

The VP, FP&A Manager will serve as a key finance partner across the organization, helping to ensure that fee revenue forecasts and related management reporting are accurate, well supported, and aligned with business expectations. The role will also directly manage a team of Fee Revenue FP&A analysts and associates supporting revenue activities and will play a leading role in strengthening revenue analytics, models, processes, systems, and controls.

**Responsibilities:**

**Fee Revenue Planning, Forecasting & Analysis**

* Lead the day-to-day management of fee revenue forecasting, budgeting, and long-range planning.
* Develop a deep understanding of key fee revenue drivers, including assets, market performance, client flows, pricing, and organic growth.
* Develop scenario and sensitivity analyses to assess revenue impacts from changes in key business and market assumptions.
* Serve as a primary FP&A partner on fee revenue matters, collaborating across Finance, Fee Operations, Client & Wealth Advisory, Investment Management, Operations, and other key stakeholders.

**Revenue Reporting & Executive Insights**

* Own recurring fee reporting and analysis for FP&A and senior management.
* Lead and support preparation of Executive Committee and Board materials on fee performance, forecasts, and long-range planning.
* Analyze revenue performance and key variance drivers, translating results into actionable executive insights.
* Ensure revenue analyses and supporting materials are accurate, reconciled, and senior management ready.
* Partner with business teams to understand underlying activity, validate assumptions, and strengthen revenue forecasting.
* Partner with firm leadership on special strategic projects and analyses for the Executive Committee and the Board of Directors.

**Client Flows & Revenue Driver Analysis**

* Enhance analytical frameworks linking client activity and asset flows to fee revenue.
* Analyze new business, existing client activity, closed business, retention, and other flow measures to assess fee revenue impacts.
* Partner with business and Finance teams to develop assumptions related to client growth, retention, pricing, and revenue realization.
* Provide greater transparency into the relationship between organic growth, markets, assets, and fee revenue.

**Revenue Models, Systems & Process Improvement**

* Own and enhance fee models, methodologies, dashboards, and analytical tools to strengthen forecasting and visibility into key revenue drivers.
* Strengthen documentation, controls, reconciliations, and review processes supporting revenue forecasting and reporting.
* Partner with Finance Technology to enhance revenue planning, forecasting, reporting, and analytics across OneStream and other Finance platforms.

**Team Management and Development**

* Manage, coach, and develop FP&A analysts and associates supporting fee revenue.
* Prioritize, allocate work, and ensure timely delivery of recurring and ad hoc analyses.
* Review team output and maintain high standards for accuracy, analytical rigor, and executive communication.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field; MBA preferred.
* Approximately 10+ years of relevant FP&A, corporate finance or related experience.
* Financial services experience preferred, including banking, wealth management, private equity, or venture capital.
* Demonstrated experience leading forecasting, financial planning, management reporting, and long-range planning.
* Strong financial modeling and analytical skills, with the ability to connect business drivers to financial performance and translate results into actionable insights.
* Proven ability to identify key trends, risks and performance drivers within complex financial data.
* Strong executive communication and business partnering skills, with experience working across functions and with senior stakeholders.
* Experience with ERP systems and financial planning software is preferred (e.g., Oracle, OneStream, Hyperion, Anaplan, SAP, or similar); Supporting system and software implementations is a plus.
* Experience with data querying using SQL and dashboarding/visualization tools (Power BI or Tableau) is a plus.
* Ability to operate independently, successfully manage direct reports, manage multiple priorities, and deliver high-quality work under recurring deadlines.

Eligible employees may participate in a 401(k) program with a generous profit-sharing contribution, medical, prescription dental, and vision coverage; life insurance; disability coverage; paid holidays; vacation; and sick time, subject to plan terms and Company policies.

Bessemer Trust is a family office, overseeing more than $250 billion in assets for over 3,000 individuals and families of substantial wealth. * Run intercompany accounting, including transactions, cross-charges, reconciliations, and elimination entries across all entities.
* Maintain a consistent chart of accounts, accounting policies, and close procedures across every entity.
* Set group-wide close calendars, reporting packages, and review standards for pillar and entity finance teams, and review their submissions before consolidation.
* Build scalable consolidation processes and tools that can absorb new entities as MTP grows.

**Close and Financial Reporting**

* Run the monthly, quarterly, and annual close for all entities on a defined, predictable calendar.
* Prepare consolidated and entity-level financial statements, including P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow.
* Oversee transactional accounting across entities; own balance sheet integrity, including intercompany transaction reconciliations.
* Partner with operations, HR, and IT so transactional data flows cleanly and accurately into the accounting records.
* Provide the CFO and leadership with accurate actuals, account analysis, and variance explanations for management reporting.

**Internal Controls and Accounting Policy**

* Establish, document, and maintain accounting policies, procedures, and internal controls.
* Own the internal control environment and risk assessment over financial reporting.
* Oversee technical accounting, including revenue recognition (ASC 606), leases (ASC 842), and business combinations (ASC 805).

**Audit and Tax**

* Coordinate the annual external audit and act as the auditors' primary day-to-day contact; resolve audit findings and implement corrective actions promptly.
* Coordinate US and Canadian tax compliance with external tax advisors, including income tax, sales tax, GST/HST, and 1099 information reporting.
* Support the CFO on tax planning and in relationships with tax advisors, banks, and other financial partners.

**Acquisitions and Integration**

* Support financial due diligence for acquisitions if needed, focusing on the quality of the target's accounting, controls, and close.
* Run accounting integration of acquired companies, including purchase accounting and opening balance sheets.
* Account for earnouts and contingent consideration, including periodic remeasurement.
* Bring new entities into the consolidation, close calendar, and control environment quickly.

**Interim Agency Head of Finance**

* Serve as interim head of finance for one of MTP's pillars, overseeing the pillar's accounting, close, and financial reporting until the existing director of finance is ready for the role.
* Deliver accurate, on-time monthly financial statements and reporting packages for the agency leadership.
* Partner with agency leadership on financial performance, margins, and client profitability, and oversee billing, collections, and payables.
* Mentor and develop existing Director of Finance, coaching on close discipline, reconciliations, technical accounting, and reporting quality.

**Team Leadership and Systems**

* Own the general ledger, consolidation, and close tools for HoldCo, including system access and controls, and drive ERP optimization, automation, and process standardization across entities.
* Support the CFO in building finance succession and development plans, and drive a culture of accountability, accuracy, and continuous improvement.
* Partner with the CFO and IT on financial systems strategy and data integrity

**Qualifications** -To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**Experience**

* 12+ years of progressive accounting and finance experience.
* 5+ years in a Controller, Assistant Controller, or equivalent senior accounting leadership role.
* Proven experience consolidating 5+ legal entities, including at least one entity outside the US.
* Hands-on experience with intercompany accounting, eliminations, and foreign currency translation.
* Experience in a corporate or group controller role overseeing the accounting of multiple business units or pillars.
* Experience leading external audits and partnering closely with a CFO.
* Track record of mentoring and developing finance leaders, not only staff accountants.

**Technical Expertise**

**A GLOBAL FIRM WITH A DIVERSE & INCLUSIVE CULTURE**

As the Global Asset Management business of Prudential, we’re always looking for ways to improve financial services. We’re passionate about making a meaningful impact - touching the lives of millions and solving financial challenges in an ever-changing world. When you join PGIM, you’ll unlock a motivating and impactful career – all while growing your skills and advancing your profession at one of the world’s leading global asset managers! If you’re not afraid to think differently and challenge the status quo, come and be a part of a dedicated team that’s investing in your future by shaping tomorrow today. At PGIM, You Can!

PGIM is the global asset management business of Prudential Financial, Inc. and one of the world's leading investment managers. With approximately $1.5 trillion in assets under management, PGIM serves institutional and individual investors across public and private markets through a broad range of investment strategies, including fixed income, equities, real estate, private credit, multi-asset and alternative investments. Through investment funds, separately managed accounts and customized investment solutions, PGIM helps clients pursue their long-term investment objectives worldwide. PGIM's investment businesses combine deep market expertise, global reach and specialized capabilities to serve pension plans, sovereign wealth funds, insurance companies, financial institutions and individual investors across global markets.

The **Vice President, Tax** supports PGIM's investment businesses and global investment platforms across multiple asset classes, including private credit and other alternative investments. The role is principally focused on providing technical tax advice and structuring support for investment products, fund structures, cross-border investments, ownership arrangements, carry and co-investment programs, and significant business initiatives across PGIM, with additional responsibility for oversight of related tax compliance and reporting matters.

The individual will combine strong technical tax expertise and sound business judgment with a working knowledge of tax compliance applicable to funds, partnering with investment, business, legal, finance and operations teams to develop practical tax solutions, support implementation and help ensure appropriate reporting and controls. The individual will advise on tax matters arising across PGIM, support the development and implementation of investment products and structures, and coordinate with tax professionals embedded within PGIM businesses and Prudential's broader tax organization. The role will also oversee recurring compliance and reporting activities and review related work prepared by internal teams and external service providers.

**The current employee work arrangement for this position is hybrid and requires your on-site presence on a reoccurring basis** as determined by your business. Your manager will provide additional details relative to the specific number of days you are expected to be on-site.

**What you can expect:**

* **Technical Tax Support and Structuring**
  + Provide technical tax support to PGIM businesses on U.S. and international tax matters affecting investment products, transactions and business initiatives.
  + Advise on tax-efficient ownership and fund investment structures, including partnerships, REITs, feeder vehicles, rated vehicles, management structures, sidecars and other domestic and international investment vehicles.
  + Monitor tax developments affecting PGIM businesses and communicate business implications and recommended actions to stakeholders.
  + Support business, legal, product and finance teams on material tax matters, including the development and implementation of new investment products and structures, and coordinate with external advisors as appropriate.
  + Advise on special projects involving tax-sensitive transactions, restructurings and regulatory developments.
* **Business and Investment Platform Support**
  + Partner with PGIM investment businesses to identify and resolve tax issues arising in the implementation and ongoing operation of funds, investment programs and strategic initiatives.
  + Provide guidance regarding investor-related tax issues, including ECI, UBTI, withholding tax and treaty considerations.

DeepMind is building frontier financial reasoning and agentic capabilities across Gemini and our enterprise agent harnesses. * Quantitative Trading
* Corporate Finance - specifically with experience across FP&A, Audit and Tax

Unlike traditional advisory roles that stop at high-level feedback or static prompt writing, you will sit directly in the model development loop alongside Research Scientists, Post-Training Engineers, and Product Managers. Portfolio construction sits at the heart of how J.P. Morgan delivers advice to clients, and the Office of Portfolio Construction (OPC) is the firm's strategic engine behind it. OPC is a major initiative for the business, with a mission to elevate portfolio construction as a core differentiator of the Private Bank and Wealth Management and equip advisors to build portfolios aligned to each client's plan, grounded in our principles, and focused on after-tax outcomes. The group is focused on three pillars — establishing portfolio construction principles, tying strategy to portfolio action, and providing advisors with customized guidance they can scale — and operates across the Private Bank and U.S. Wealth Management, supporting 7,000+ advisors and more than $750B in investment assets. Our north star is embedding our advice and methodologies into the AI-powered tools (ConnectWealth and Portfolio Builder) that scale portfolio advice across every advisor.

You'll work alongside senior Strategists and partner closely with Global Investment Strategy, Investments Research, Managed Investments, Due Diligence, and regional Investments & Advice leaders — gaining a broad, cross-asset view of how portfolios actually get built through an after-tax lens at one of the world's leading wealth managers.

Reporting to the Director of Strategic Intelligence and Pipeline, the Market Intelligence Analyst is responsible for generating high-quality leads and producing the external market insight required to build tomorrow's pipeline.

Generate a continuous flow of credible, evidence-based leads across priority sectors, services and geographies. Identify opportunities early enough to support market shaping, relationship development and organizational readiness.

* Proactively scan target markets for new contracts, funding streams, grants, frameworks and adjacent growth opportunities.

Build a current, practical understanding of commissioners, funders and procurement bodies to strengthen lead generation and market positioning. Translate published priorities, budgets and commissioning intentions into clear implications for growth.

* Track consultations, market engagement events, pipeline publications and recommissioning cycles.

* Assess growth drivers, customer demand, funding outlook, barriers to entry and route-to-market considerations.
* Support market-entry, geography and service-line assessments.

* Identify market gaps, likely competitive pressure and potential areas of differentiation.

* Maintain organized repositories for markets, commissioners, funders, procurements and competitors.

description:
Overview

Catalyst Brands is seeking a Senior Financial Analyst to support financial planning, forecasting, reporting, and business analysis for our Lifestyle Brands, including Aéropostale, Lucky Brand, and Nautica. This hybrid role is based in Lyndhurst, New Jersey, with three days onsite and two days remote each week.
  
  
The position partners with Finance, Accounting, and Brand business leaders to evaluate performance across retail, e-commerce, and wholesale channels. You will analyze business drivers, explain financial variances, and deliver actionable insights that shape strategic business decisions.  
  
A well-qualified candidate blends proficient financial planning and analysis (FP&A) skills with a corporate accounting foundation, possessing an innate curiosity and ability of translating operational activities into clear financial narratives.

  
  
Responsibilities

**Financial Planning & Analysis:** Drive and support annual budgeting, monthly forecasting, and long-range planning across retail, e-commerce, wholesale, and corporate operations for Aéropostale, Lucky Brand, and Nautica.

**Financial Modeling:** Develop and maintain financial models with clearly documented reasonable assumptions.

**Variance & Performance Analysis:** Analyze sales, gross margin, operating expenses (SG&A), and overall profitability against budget, forecast, and prior periods. Diagnose the underlying root causes of financial variances.

**Accounting & General Ledger Integrity:** Analyze GL accounts and transaction-level details to validate monthly financial results and investigate unexpected variances. Partner closely with Accounting during month-end close to assess accrual needs and resolve discrepancies.

**Commercial Analysis:** Analyze the impacts of pricing strategies, product volume, category mix, and product costs on overall sales and gross margin performance across different brand channels.

**Presentations:** Partner cross-functionally to prepare and present clear financial results, forecasts, and strategic recommendations to senior leadership.

  
  
Qualifications

**Required:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related quantitative field.
* 2 years of relevant experience in FP&A, corporate finance, or a combination of accounting and financial analysis.
* Advanced Excel capabilities (complex formulas, lookups, index/match, pivot tables, and driver-based modeling) with a demonstrated ability to self-audit work.
* Proficient written and verbal communication skills; ability to build cross-functional relationships.

**Preferred:**

* Knowledge of retail and/or wholesale business models, including their unique financial drivers.
* Prior finance or accounting experience within the apparel, footwear, retail, or consumer packaged goods (CPG) sectors.
* Experience with enterprise systems and reporting tools, such as Oracle, OneStream, or MicroStrategy.

If eligible, we offer a competitive benefits package including medical/dental/vision, term life insurance, paid vacation/holidays\*, and 401(k) with Company match. All store hourly associates scheduled to work on a designated holiday will receive additional compensation. \*For paid vacation days, as well as eligibility requirements for other benefits, please visit www.catalystbrandsbenefits.com

Catalyst Brands reflects the bringing together the rich heritages of our brands with modern excitement and a new vision for success. Five iconic brands came together under a unified powerhouse portfolio to celebrate the essence of American style. We will leverage our rich history, resources and best-in-class industry talent to further build the success of our brands. At Catalyst we are united in one shared purpose: We exist to ignite America’s most beloved retail brands to make fashion accessible to all.

Working at Catalyst means joining a dedicated team of associates who are encouraged to be uniquely themselves in a safe, caring and welcoming environment. It is a place where careers prosper, accomplishments are celebrated and diversity flourishes. It’s a place that’s meant for you.

* Demonstrated experience in designing experiments and using data-driven insights to solve business problems.

description:
**Who We Are**
==============

At Justworks, you'll enjoy a welcoming and casual environment, great benefits, wellness program offerings, company retreats, and the ability to interact with and learn from leaders in the startup community. We work hard and care about our most prized asset - our people.

We're helping businesses get off the ground by enabling them to focus on running their business. We solve HR issues. We're data-driven and never stop iterating. If you'd like to work in a supportive, entrepreneurial environment, are interested in building something meaningful and having fun while doing it, we'd love to hear from you.

We're united by shared goals and shared motivations at Justworks. These are best summed up in our company values, which are reflected in our product and in our team.

Our Values

If this sounds like you, you'll fit right in.

**Who You Are**

Reporting into the Senior Manager, Strategy Operations, you'll balance strategic thinking, program execution, and analytical rigor in equal measure. You'll own the execution and delivery of strategic initiatives—refining and maintaining the operating system, designing the operating rhythms and decision mechanisms that allow Operations to scale from foundational work into systems at scale.

You're energized by environments where parts of the organization are still stabilizing, others are being brought together under shared standards, and new operating capabilities must be built from scratch. You bring strong operational judgment and the ability to translate strategic direction into results. You're equally comfortable building a 90-day roadmap, driving a cross-functional initiative to completion, or diving into metrics to understand what's working and what's not.

In this role, success looks like building the systems and operating infrastructure that allow Operations to scale as a cohesive, well-run division by raising the bar on how our people work and supporting the identification and execution of our highest-leverage opportunities.

**Your Success Profile**

**What You Will Work On**

* **Partner with Operations Leadership** to identify the highest-impact opportunities to improve how Operations operates, with a focus on reducing customer and operational effort at scale.
* **Run the operating system**, including planning rhythms, execution cadences, reporting, and accountability mechanisms.
* **Build and maintain** AI-powered workflows that reduce the administrative layer of running the operating system, enabling the team to focus on higher-value work.
* **Lead and drive operations programs** **and initiatives** from definition through execution, while effectively partnering with Technology, Finance & Accounting, and Customer Success teams to coordinate dependencies, align on requirements, and resolve execution bottlenecks.
* **Leverage data** to identify trends and translate insights into actionable recommendations that inform strategy and decision-making across the function.

* **Influence Without Authority**: You build trust with peers and leaders across the organization. You coordinate complex efforts through relationship and clarity, not formal power.
* **Adaptability**: You stay steady in a changing environment. You learn quickly, find where you can add most value, and shift focus when priorities change. You're equally comfortable facilitating a meeting or diving into Jira to untangle a workflow.

* **Camaraderie** - Day to day you can be seen working together toward a higher purpose. You like to have fun. You're an active listener, treat people respectfully, and have a strong desire to know and help others.
* **Openness** - Your default is to be open. You're willing to share information, understand other perspectives, and consider new possibilities. You're curious, ask open questions, and are receptive to thoughts and feedback from others.
* **Grit** - You demonstrate grit by having the courage to commit and persevere. You're committed, earnest, and dive in to get the job done well with a positive attitude.
* **Integrity** - Simply put, do what you say and say what you'll do. You're honest and forthright, have a strong moral compass, and strive to match your words with your actions while leading by example.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Our client runs the compliant system of record you build on to move, store, and grow money. Launch financial products your customers love. We provide the financial primitives, licenses, and compliance, and our forward deployed team gets you live in two weeks. Under the hood, fiat and blockchain run as one system. Their customers never see any of it. Money comes in, money goes out, and it just gets there.

**The Role**

Our customers don't just call our APIs. They build their products on us. Their balances, their payment operations, their compliance state. Which means our business succeeds exactly as far as theirs do. Forward Deployed Engineering is the team that makes that true, one customer at a time.

You'll report to our CTO and embed with one strategic customer at a time, the enterprises building their products where we're investing deepest. You'll understand their business, their constraints, and their pain points better than anyone, and then you'll build what their launch needs.

Here's a concrete example. A global payouts customer is expanding into a new market where we don't yet have local account infrastructure. You scope the requirements with their engineering team, then build the virtual account infrastructure, in our core codebase, that their launch depends on. When it ships, it's not a one-off. It becomes a core product that we sell to the next ten customers.

That's the defining property of this role. This is not a services role, and it's not technical support. You're a product engineer whose roadmap comes from a live customer instead of a planning doc. Everything you build lands in the core platform, and the best of it becomes product the whole company resells. Engagements are scoped at contract time. You're delivering what we've committed to, not absorbing unbounded requests. But within that scope, the what, the why, and the how are yours to figure out with the customer.

**What You'll Do**

* **Deploy into customer contexts.** Iterate daily with your customer's engineering and operations teams, mostly over Zoom and Slack, with some travel to spend real time on site.
* **Scope the build with the customer.** You're not handed a spec. You work out what to build and why with the customer directly, paired with a deployment strategist who owns the commercial side.
* **Build across the full stack.** TypeScript and React, NestJS with Postgres and Prisma, and AWS (SQS, SNS, Lambda). New account infrastructure, blockchain integrations, API endpoints, compliance workflows, whatever the launch requires.
* **Generalize the bespoke.** Identify patterns across implementations and work with product to turn engagement output into first-class platform features.
* **Prototype fast, ship carefully.** Rapid iteration against live customer workflows, accepting some throwaway work and making sure what isn't throwaway gets productized properly, all while debugging production issues in real time, sometimes with the customer watching.
* **Design for correctness and auditability.** This is money-movement infrastructure. Edge cases have real consequences, and you think about failure modes before they happen.
* **Communicate crisply** with customer engineers, operators, founders, and finance leaders, and with our own product leads, whose pods your work must generalize into.

**Who You Are**

* **You're a builder first.** We're flexible on tenure. We'll hire a scrappy engineer straight out of school or a seasoned customer-facing engineer. We're not flexible on the bar. You ship production-grade, full-stack work, and you have something you've built to prove it.
* **You're AI-native.** Agentic tools are how you already build, and we'll ask you to show us.
* **You're energized by customers, not shielded from them.** You're comfortable operating directly with an enterprise engineering team, under ambiguity, where the requirements are yours to discover.
* **You're obsessed with correctness and resilience.** You love a good state machine. You think carefully about what happens when things go wrong, because with money they can't.
* **Strong pluses.** Payments and fintech infrastructure experience, blockchain and stablecoin integration work, and a forward-deployed or solutions architect background where you *built* rather than just configured.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Your customer launches on time, on our rails, and their volume ramps because what you built works.
* The infrastructure you shipped for one customer is now core product being sold to the next ten.
* Your customer's engineering team treats you as one of their own, and our team trusts what you merge.
* You've defined, alongside our CTO, what "forward deployed" means.
* You're an early member of a function we're building the company around.

**How We Work**

We run on three principles:

* **2% better, every day.** One percent for yourself, one percent for the people around you.
* **Telos.** From the Greek word telos, meaning not just done but fulfilled. Everyone here is focused on one mission and knows each other's Telos.
* **Build.** Embody the builder's mindset. Make things, solve problems, and have fun doing it.

Location: NYC or Denver

About Us: We're a recruiting, staffing, and placement company for Startups.

Please submit your resume. If you're a good fit, we will connect you directly with our client who is hiring for this role.

Work Location: In person

title: Director of Product, Mobile
description:
CLEAR is building THE secure identity company of the future. Our mission is to make experiences safer and easier—physically and digitally. With more than 43 million Members and a growing network of partners across the world, CLEAR's secure identity platform is transforming the way people live, work, and travel. Whether it's at the airport, stadium, or throughout your everyday life, CLEAR unlocks the magic of frictionless experiences.

We are looking for a visionary, customer-obsessed, and technology-focused product management leader with expertise in building and scaling consumer mobile experiences. As Director of Product, Mobile, you will own the strategy, roadmap, and outcomes for CLEAR's mobile app, shaping it from a collection of features into an intelligent, trusted travel companion that helps members prepare, navigate, and recover throughout their journey.

You will build the mobile app into the most helpful digital layer of the travel day and be accountable for driving adoption, engagement, and member value. You will connect CLEAR's identity capabilities, real-time travel context, airport operations, member relationships, and partner-enabled services into experiences that are personalized, proactive, and genuinely useful before, during, and after travel. This includes helping members understand airport conditions, find the right path through the airport, discover food and lounge options, and access relevant CLEAR and partner services in the moments that matter.

The ideal candidate has a proven history of setting bold product visions, leading through ambiguity, and delivering scalable, high-quality technology solutions that create meaningful customer value and support rapid learning and iteration. This role will initially lead a small product team with one direct report and will operate as a player-coach: setting a high bar for product thinking and execution while developing talent and scaling the team over time.

***What You'll Do:***

* Establish CLEAR's Mobile app strategic vision and product roadmap in alignment with enterprise goals and member needs. Translate a multi-year vision into a small number of strategic bets, prioritized product investments, structured sequencing, and clear success metrics.
* Own the mobile product portfolio end to end, including strategy, discovery, prioritization, delivery, launch, and ongoing optimization across iOS and Android.
* Transform the app into an intelligent travel companion that guides members through preparation, real-time navigation, food ordering, lounge discovery and access, and travel disruptions.
* Define and deliver proactive, context-aware experiences that translate real-time conditions into useful next actions including personalized timing, wayfinding, disruption support, family and group coordination, service recommendations, airport conditions and availability, and timely human assistance when digital guidance is not enough.
* Extend the app's value beyond the airport by creating reasons for members to return, share travel with family and friends, discover benefits, and build a deeper relationship with CLEAR.
* Be accountable for measurable business and customer outcomes, including mobile app adoption, activation, engagement, member retention, and contribution to CLEAR's broader membership and subscription goals.
* Build and lead a high-performing product team. Initially manage and develop one direct report, establish clear ownership and decision rights, coach for stronger product judgment and execution, and grow the team as the scope requires.
* Create a durable product operating model that supports fast learning and responsible scale, including strong analytics, experimentation, reliability, accessibility, platform foundations, and consistent product development rituals.
* Use customer research, analytics, experimentation, rapid prototyping, and member feedback to decide where to go deep, where to learn quickly, and where to say no.
* Collaborate closely with Engineering, Design, Finance, Operations, Member Care, Marketing, Security, Legal, and partner teams to build shared conviction, align trade-offs, and deliver a multi-year transformation.
* Connect the digital app to the physical airport experience, CLEAR's service teams, and partner ecosystem so the best member experiences extend beyond the phone including airport information, food ordering, lounge access, Concierge, and other services with Ambassadors, airport operations, and partners.
* Communicate product strategy, progress, trade-offs, and results clearly to senior leadership, creating organizational alignment while remaining open to better ideas and new evidence.

***What You're Great At:***

* 10+ years of product management experience, with significant experience building and scaling consumer mobile products.
* Proven ability to set an inspiring product vision, identify the few strategic bets that matter most, and sequence the work required to make that future real.
* Demonstrated experience leading, coaching, and developing product managers or product teams, including as a player-coach in a growing organization.
* A track record of delivering large-scale mobile app initiatives, managing technical trade-offs, and ensuring architecture is scalable, secure, reliable, and accessible across iOS and Android.
* Strong customer empathy and the ability to turn member needs, qualitative research, and behavioral data into clear product decisions and compelling experiences.
* Ability to establish a data-driven culture around metrics such as mobile app acquisition, activation, engagement, retention, and member or subscription conversion.
* Experience connecting digital products to physical-world operations, service teams, and partner ecosystems.
* Exceptional strategic prioritization, organizational, and execution skills, with the ability to create clarity and drive focus in complex and dynamic contexts.
* Strong executive communication and influencing skills; able to align diverse stakeholders around a clear point of view, navigate disagreement, and make thoughtful decisions with imperfect information.
* A growth mindset, high ownership, and a bias toward action, balanced with the judgment to invest in durable foundations and earn customer trust release after release.
* Living and imparting CLEAR's core values: Be Indefatigable, Bias for Action, Embrace Change, Obsessed with the Customer Experience, Speak Up, Our Great People, Own It.

***How You'll be Rewarded:***

At CLEAR, we help YOU move forward - because when you're at your best, we're at our best. You'll work with talented team members motivated by our mission of making experiences safer and easier. Our offices are bright and energetic with an open concept and plenty of conference rooms and casual co-working spaces. We also offer catered lunches every day and have fully stocked kitchens. Outside of the office, we invest in your well-being and learning & development with stipends and reimbursement programs.

We offer holistic total rewards, including comprehensive healthcare plans, family-building benefits (fertility and adoption/surrogacy support), flexible time off, annual wellness stipend, free OneMedical memberships for you and your dependents, a CLEAR Plus membership, and a 401(k) retirement plan with employer match. title: SVP, Business Development
description:
**SVP, Business Development (NY, NY)**

Marquee Brands owns and manages a portfolio of global brands across consumer products and channels in Home & Culinary, Luxury, Fashion, and Sports & Active. Our team is committed to driving organic growth through natural brand extensions, impactful marketing and direct consumer engagement. Our promise is to keep our brands’ storied success going through relevant product and expanded distribution, geographic expansion, while staying true to each brand’s founding message and origin.

**Job Summary**

Marquee Brands is looking for a senior business development leader to contribute to and run the company’s new business strategy across its whole brand portfolio. Reporting to the Chief Business Development Officer, the SVP of Business Development will play a key role in executing the licensing growth agenda. They will lead a team of business development professionals, open and close transformational partnerships, and act as a senior face of Marquee Brands to licensees, retailers and industry partners around the world.

The SVP will find and prioritize the highest-value opportunities across brands, categories, channels and geographies, in line with each brand’s DNA and long-term strategy. They will work as a strategic partner to the executive team and to brand, marketing, legal and finance leaders. This person will turn portfolio strategy into a disciplined pipeline that produces revenue and will personally lead the most complex and important deals.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategy & Leadership**

* Set and carry out the business development strategy across the portfolio, including annual and multi-year revenue targets, category expansion plans and international growth priorities.
* Build, lead, mentor and grow a high-performing business development team (Directors, Managers and Coordinators). Set clear goals, KPIs and accountability.
* Work with executive leadership on portfolio strategy, including evaluating the licensing potential of possible brand acquisitions and building growth plans for newly acquired brands.
* Own business development forecasting and pipeline management.

  

**Growth & Deal Execution**

* Grow revenue across the portfolio by finding, vetting and signing strong licensees in new product categories, channels and territories.
* Personally originate and lead the company’s largest and most strategic deals, including multi-category, multi-territory, direct-to-retail and master license agreements.
* Oversee the full deal process from origination through term-sheet structuring, negotiation and execution. Make sure deal economics, guarantees and partner quality meet company standards.
* Lead complex contract negotiations, working closely with legal counsel and finance.

* Build and keep executive relationships with C-suite decision-makers at top manufacturers, retailers, distributors and international agents.

* 15+ years of progressive experience in brand licensing and new business development, including at least 5 years in a senior leadership role (VP level or above).
* Proven record of originating and closing large, complex licensing agreements, and of consistently meeting or exceeding significant revenue targets.
* Experience building, leading and developing high-performing business development teams.
* Extensive network of senior relationships across licensees, retailers and distribution partners, in both domestic and international markets.
* Deep knowledge of licensee business models, product categories, retail channels, deal structures and international territories.
* Strong experience in Home & Culinary preferred, with exposure to Fashion, Luxury and Sports & Outdoor.

Willing to travel domestically and internationally
