title: Director of Design
description:
**Company Overview:**

With an annual budget of $2.3 billion and more than 7,000 employees throughout the five boroughs, the New York City Department of Health and Mental Hygiene (NYC DOHMH) is one of the largest public health agencies in the world, serving 8 million New Yorkers from diverse ethnic and cultural backgrounds. We're tackling a broad range of public health issues with innovative policies and programs and getting exceptional results, but our work is never finished. The breadth of our innovative programs provides the widest range of choices for every member of our team.

With grant funds from the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), DOHMH is undertaking a new initiative that will meet critical infrastructure needs and make possible strategic investments that will have lasting effects on public health. Investments and improvements through this initiative will help modernize DOHMH’s foundational capabilities and data infrastructure, enabling it to partner in complex health and health care environments and, in turn, support better public health outcomes, including COVID-19. This initiative supports larger efforts to rebalance investments in public health and more equitably serve communities and populations.

The selected candidate will be an employee of Public Health Solutions, a nonprofit organization which is the fiscal and administrative manager of the grant but will work be supervised by DOHMH. **This is a grant-funded position ending in November 2027.**

**Program Overview:**

The Office of External Affairs manages many of the agency’s most critical interactions with the public, from raising awareness and promoting healthy behaviors to advancing policies and responding to health emergencies. The Bureau of Communications, housed within the Office of External Affairs, develops culturally responsive public health marketing campaigns; generates and crafts materials to inform New Yorkers of health information and program services, ensuring accessibility for all; provides access to translation services for collateral materials and clinics; maintains the agency’s website; and publishes content on the agency’s social media platforms. Within Creative Communications, the Design group oversees the artwork, design, layout, and creation of print and digital media to inform New Yorkers of key health topics and emergency situations.

**Job Description:**

DOHMH has an opening for a Director of Design. The Director of Design is responsible for the look and feel, creation, and development of program-specific and/or Health Department-wide creative projects, in collaboration with the larger Creative Communications team. The Director oversees the day-to-day operations of the Design team, workflow, and management of staff.

**Specifically, the Director of Design will:**

* Oversee and approve look and feel of al design projects and requests. Monitor project deliverables and timelines and takes corrective action as needed.
* Advance the Health Department’s mission and strategic plan by generating attention-grabbing, accessible, and high-quality designs. Maintain the Health Department’s brand identity across many different topics. Demonstrate strategic thinking and planning in the creation of collateral and other design materials.
* Lead the Design group, a team of graphic designers and videographers.
* Provide strategic guidance, creative direction, and hands-on support to team members in execution of assigned projects.
* As a supervisor, the Director will foster productivity and accountability, support professional development, encourage teamwork, and lead the group’s collaboration with colleagues across the agency.
* Select and manage activities of contracted vendors and consultants to procure design and printing services as needed and ensure that appropriate contracts are in place.
* Coordinate and collaborate with other members of the Creative Communications team (Editorial, Digital Communications, Marketing, and Language Services) as projects call for interaction and support. Work closely with the Editorial team to develop and maintain art for priority messaging and health education materials and with the Digital Communications team for the Health Department’s website and social media pages.
* Liaise with Health Department divisions and bureaus and effectively foster relationships throughout the Health Department community with a diverse range of stakeholders to improve collaboration.
* Function effectively within Creative Communications leadership team as a senior design, creative, and strategy resource, demonstrating leadership and sharing experience.
* Approve the use of the Health Department logo on materials created outside the Communications team.

**Qualifications****:**

* A master’s degree from an accredited college or university with a major in business administration, public administration, urban planning, economics, urban affairs, marketing research, finance, or political science and three years of satisfactory full-time professional experience handling business promotion related to capital projects, urban planning, economic development, or financial development at least two years of which must have been in a managerial or executive capacity; or
* A baccalaureate degree from an accredited college or university and five years of satisfactory full-time professional experience as described in "1" above, including two years of managerial or executive experience described in "1" above; or
* A satisfactory combination of education and/or experience equivalent to "1" or "2" above. Thirty (30) graduate semester credits from an accredited college or university will be considered equivalent to one year of the required experience. However, all candidates must have two years of managerial or executive experience as described in "1" above and a four-year high school diploma or its educational equivalent.
* Experience in a managerial capacity must include, but is not limited to, responsibilities such as: strategic planning for an office/division; creating and implementing policies; setting standards and best practices defining and documenting project scope; root cause analysis with recommendations; collaborating with other managers and executives to define future state of a program; and/or forecasting.
* Experience in an executive capacity must include, but is not limited to, responsibilities such as managing multiple bureaus, areas and/or divisions; formulating the organizational strategy/governance; formulating the organization's architectural strategy; developing, setting and enforcing the organization's policies; developing partnerships; and/or developing the organization's budget, cost savings, and revenue generation.

**Additional Desired Qualities:**

* Demonstrate knowledge of graphic design, photography, videography, web design, and print production and strategic, creative, and critical thinking.
* Ability to communicate complex messages through clear and simple design to highly diverse New York City audiences.
* Self-motivated with exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.
* Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage and prioritize multiple projects, tasks, and timelines.
* Demonstrates a professional, courteous, and respectful attitude in dealing with colleagues, direct reports, leadership, and stakeholders.
* Ability to supervise, delegate, and provide consultation and technical assistance to individual program components on media communications.
* Leadership abilities in developing and motivating professional staff, including developing in-service training and resources to enhance performance and growth.
* Capacity to identify new strategies to meet the agency’s overall mission and communications mission

* Hybrid Work Schedule.
* Generous Paid Time Off and Holidays.

* Influence beyond your own team: moving engineers, PMs, and GTM leads through trust, framing, and timing, not by invoking the CTO's name.

**Nice to have, but not required**

* Experience building production systems with LLMs, agents, evals, or retrieval.

description:

We are looking for a detail-oriented, experienced Bookkeeper to play a key role in supporting our daily accounting and financial operations. Partnering closely with our finance leadership, you will manage day-to-day transactions, complete multi-account reconciliations, oversee outgoing vendor payments, and support month-end financial reporting. Beyond standard data entry, the ideal candidate is a proactive problem-solver who thrives at establishing structured workflows, enforcing financial controls, and resolving account discrepancies.

● Perform daily and monthly bank, credit card, and platform reconciliations (QuickBooks

Online, Bill.com, and Chase accounts), including high-volume monthly statements.

● Investigate and resolve financial discrepancies to ensure accurate reconciliations and

zero-balance ledger closures.

● Maintain basic reconciliations and banking for different entities, including periodic

physical branch deposits when remote scanning is unavailable.

Expense Management & Corporate Cards

● Manage the Brex corporate card portal, ensuring all transactions are reviewed, receipts

are submitted by employees, business purposes are validated, and expenses are

correctly categorized.

● Review and process employee travel expense reimbursement requests, ensuring

required documentation and receipts are attached before approval.

● Monitor daily account activity and promptly flag unusually large or unexpected

transactions for management review.

● Review and process incoming vendor bills in Bill.com, prioritizing urgent deadlines, and

maintain accurate vendor records and W-9 forms.

● Prepare and initiate approved electronic payments (ACH and wire transfers), acting as

primary backup coverage when Senior Leadership is out of office.

● Maintain daily bookkeeping entries in QuickBooks Online, ensuring proper handling of

customer payments, credit memos, and refunds.

● Post incoming checks and report any payment/check discrepancies to the internal AR or

invoicing teams.

● Assist with month-end close workflows as the company transitions from cash-basis to

accrual accounting, compile year-end 1099 vendor lists for the outside CPA, and support

ad hoc reporting needs.

● Maintain strict confidentiality regarding company finances, bank accounts, vendor rates,

and employee payroll/reimbursements.

**Qualifications**

● 2–5 years of practical experience in accounts payable, accounts receivable, or general

bookkeeping.

● Strong daily proficiency with QuickBooks Online and functional working knowledge of MS

Excel.

● Solid grasp of core bookkeeping concepts, fundamental internal controls, and proper

entry distinction.

● A detail-oriented problem solver with high accuracy and analytical skills.

● Uncompromising integrity and discretion when managing sensitive corporate financial

information.

● Collaborative, team-focused mindset paired with a pragmatic approach to daily tasks.

● Aptitude for leveraging AI tools to enhance work efficiency and support daily operations.

Pay: $75,000.00 - $95,000.00 per year

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Tucker Ellis LLP is seeking an experienced Billing & Collections Manager to lead and oversee the firm's billing and collections operations. This leadership role is responsible for managing key aspects of the firm's revenue cycle, ensuring accurate and timely billing, strengthening collection efforts, and improving overall financial performance.

The Billing & Collections Manager will work closely with attorneys, practice group leaders, Finance leadership, and administrative teams to streamline billing processes, resolve complex billing and collection issues, improve cash flow, and ensure exceptional client service. The ideal candidate will bring extensive law firm billing and collections experience, strong leadership and analytical skills, and a demonstrated ability to develop efficient processes and lead a high-performing team.

* Manage day-to-day billing operations, including pre-bill review, invoice generation, electronic billing (eBilling), invoice submission, billing adjustments, and resolution of billing discrepancies.
* Oversee collection activities and accounts receivable management, developing strategies to improve collection rates, reduce outstanding balances, and accelerate cash flow.
* Partner with attorneys, practice group leaders, and Finance leadership to address billing concerns, resolve collection challenges, and ensure timely invoicing and payment.
* Monitor work-in-process (WIP) and accounts receivable balances, identify potential issues, and coordinate with attorneys to facilitate timely billing and collections.
* Develop, implement, and maintain billing and collections procedures that promote consistency, accuracy, efficiency, and compliance with firm policies.
* Monitor key performance indicators, including billing turnaround times, collection performance, realization, and Days Sales Outstanding (DSO), and provide reporting and recommendations to Finance leadership.
* Ensure compliance with client billing guidelines, outside counsel guidelines, engagement terms, and electronic billing requirements.
* Oversee the resolution of rejected invoices, payment discrepancies, short payments, and other billing or collection issues.
* Collaborate with Finance and Information Technology teams to optimize the use of Aderant, improve reporting capabilities, streamline workflows, and support system enhancements.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement and automation to increase productivity, improve accuracy, and strengthen the firm's revenue cycle.
* Prepare and analyze billing, collections, and accounts receivable reports to identify trends, monitor performance, and support financial planning and decision-making.
* Establish priorities, allocate resources, and manage team workloads to ensure deadlines are met and service expectations are consistently achieved.

* Maintain effective working relationships with attorneys, firm leadership, clients, and administrative professionals to support the firm's financial objectives.
* Maintain the highest level of confidentiality when handling sensitive financial, client, and firm information.

**Education & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree (undergraduate degree) in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field required.
* Minimum of five (5) years of progressive experience in legal billing, collections, accounts receivable, or revenue cycle management, preferably within a law firm.
* Previous supervisory or management experience leading billing, collections, or accounting personnel, including coaching, mentoring, performance management, and employee development.
* Hands-on Aderant experience required, including familiarity with billing workflows, financial reporting, and related system functions.

title: Founding GTM
description:
#### **About GoodRec**

GoodRec makes it easy to play sports. Every week, more than **20,000 people** use GoodRec to play sports and meet people in person. We organized over **65,000 games in 2025** and are on track for more in 2026.

We’re building the platform for recreational sports — starting with pickup games and expanding into every way you play.

#### **About the Role**

We’re looking for an ambitious, entrepreneurial GTM to accelerate growth at Goodrec.You’ll work directly with the CEO on some of the company’s highest-priority growth problems.

One month you might launch a new growth channel. The next you might develop a strategic partnership, help crack a market, or test an entirely new business line.

Your job is simple: **find opportunities to grow GoodRec, prove they work, and turn them into scalable playbooks.**

#### **What You’ll Do**

* Launch and scale new growth initiatives
* Identify and test new business lines
* Develop strategic partnerships
* Test new acquisition and distribution channels
* Research markets, competitors, and growth opportunities
* Analyze customer and business data to find opportunities
* Talk directly with customers and partners
* Take ideas from **hypothesis test results scalable process**
* Build systems and processes where none exist today
* Work directly with the CEO and leadership team on company priorities

This isn’t a traditional sales role, and it isn’t a traditional strategy role. You’ll be expected to **figure out what will move the business forward and then make it happen.**

#### **Who We’re Looking For**

You have roughly **2–3 years of professional experience** and a track record of being excellent at what you do.

You:

* Are extremely smart, curious, and resourceful
* Have grit and can will things into existence
* Move quickly without needing much structure
* Think analytically but love execution
* Take ownership instead of waiting for direction
* Are comfortable selling, analyzing data, and building a process in the same day
* Communicate clearly and confidently
* Have high standards and care about details
* Want significantly more responsibility than most roles give someone early in their career
* Are excited by startups and building things from scratch

Experience in startups, consulting, growth, operations, business development, finance, or similar environments is helpful, but **we care much more about ability, trajectory, and evidence that you can get things done.**

#### **Why GoodRec**

* **Real ownership.** You’ll own projects that directly affect company growth.
* **Work directly with the CEO.** You’ll be involved in some of the most important problems and decisions in the company.
* **Build, don’t maintain.** You’ll constantly launch, test, and create things that don’t exist yet.
* **Meaningful scale.** We already connect 20,000+ people every week, but we believe GoodRec can become dramatically larger.
* **Grow with the company.** If you prove you can build and scale something, you’ll have the opportunity to own increasingly large parts of the business.

If you want a highly structured job with narrowly defined responsibilities, this probably isn’t the right role.

If you want to **build, move fast, and help create the future of recreational sports**, we’d love to meet you.

#### **Compensation**

The budgeted base salary range for this role is $70,000–$100,000. Base salary may vary depending on experience, skills and business needs. In addition to base pay, GoodRec offers healthcare benefits and paid time off.

We want lenders, platforms, and depository institutions to originate on Figure's loan origination system, through private-label programs, embedded and SaaS-style integrations, and direct adoption. As a member of NJCC’s senior leadership team, the Managing Director sets the organization’s fundraising and capitalization strategy, leads the development of a multi-year capitalization plan in partnership with the CEO, Chief Financial Officer, and Chief Operating Officer, and is accountable for annual revenue goals. The Managing Director also oversees NJCC’s government affairs and communications and marketing function, working with a communications associate and NJCC’s outside communications/PR consultant to manage NJCC’s public voice and submit grant applications, as needed. The Managing Director partners with program, real estate, and lending teams to track and report the organization’s impact numbers to funders and the public, and works closely with senior leadership and the Board.

Requirements:

**Responsibilities**

**Resource Development & Fundraising**

* Lead NJCC’s fundraising and capitalization efforts, setting annual revenue goals, plans, and strategies and developing a multi-year capitalization plan with senior leadership.

* Proactively schedule and lead a regular cadence of in-person and virtual meetings with current and prospective funders; build and maintain a pipeline of prospects, drawing on an existing network of professional contacts.
* Identify, research, and pursue new capital, grant, sponsorship, and program related investment (PRI) opportunities aligned with NJCC’s lending, real estate, and community development programs, including debt and equity capital for lending and the design of new capital strategies and products, with assistance of the team.

The successful candidate will analyze spending patterns, compare supplier pricing, assess purchasing trends, and help ensure that ingredients, packaging materials, and restaurant supplies are obtained efficiently and cost-effectively. This role requires strong analytical abilities, attention to detail, and effective collaboration with procurement, inventory, kitchen, and management teams.

Key Responsibilities

* Analyze purchasing data for pizza ingredients, including flour, dough, cheese, tomatoes, sauces, meats, vegetables, and seasonings.

* Compare supplier quotations, product quality, delivery terms, and pricing structures.
* Monitor price fluctuations and evaluate their potential impact on food costs and operating budgets.
* Analyze historical usage, sales patterns, and inventory data to support purchasing forecasts.
* Prepare purchasing reports, cost comparisons, and performance summaries for management.
* Coordinate with procurement personnel to review purchase orders and identify unusual spending.
* Evaluate supplier performance using pricing, product quality, order accuracy, and delivery reliability.
* Identify opportunities to reduce waste, improve order quantities, and avoid unnecessary purchases.
* Work with inventory staff to investigate stock discrepancies and purchasing variances.
* Help establish purchasing benchmarks and track performance against approved budgets.
* Maintain accurate records of supplier quotations, pricing histories, purchasing data, and analytical findings.
* Support negotiations by providing data-driven recommendations on supplier pricing and purchasing volumes.
* Monitor the availability and cost of packaging materials, beverages, cleaning products, and other restaurant supplies.
* Recommend improvements to purchasing procedures, reporting methods, and procurement efficiency.

Qualifications and Requirements

* Bachelor's degree in business analytics, finance, supply chain management, accounting, economics, or a related field preferred.
* Previous experience in purchasing analysis, procurement, inventory management, or financial reporting is an advantage.
* Strong numerical, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency in spreadsheets, including formulas, sorting, filtering, and data analysis.
* Familiarity with purchasing systems, inventory software, or reporting tools.
* Ability to interpret cost trends and communicate findings clearly.
* Strong attention to detail and recordkeeping abilities.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple assignments and meet reporting deadlines.
* Understanding of food costs, supplier pricing, and inventory practices is beneficial.

Preferred Skills

* Purchasing data analysis and cost reporting.
* Supplier price comparison and performance evaluation.
* Budget monitoring and spending analysis.
* Demand forecasting and purchasing trend analysis.
* Inventory reconciliation and waste reduction.
* Spreadsheet reporting and data visualization.

title: Principal Platform Product Manager - Billing & Authentication
description:
At Constant Contact, we are seriously awesome people who take ownership and make an impact by operating with the mindset, integrity and courage of a small business owner. *There's something so profoundly rewarding about knowing that your work is empowering people everywhere to pursue their dreams*. Here, we all play an integral part in helping business owners, entrepreneurs, non-profits and individuals to succeed by giving them all the help and tools they need to grow online. We're energized by new challenges and new possibilities-and we're just getting started!

We have an opening for a Principal Platform Product Manager to lead the definition of Constant Contact's core services, with particular focus on authentication and billing. These are the services every product we ship is built on: how a customer signs in, what their plan lets them do, and how what they use turns into revenue. You will set the direction for them, decide what we build and in what order, and define how they should behave so the teams that depend on them can move quickly and trust the result.

The first job is billing. We are moving from an in-house billing system to Stripe Billing, and hundreds of thousands of small businesses count on us getting it right. Alongside it, we are modernizing identity: sign-in, single sign-on, and the account and access model behind them. As those stabilize, the scope of this role grows with the business. Entitlements, account structure, partner and reseller models, and whatever core service we need next are all fair game for someone who has earned the trust to take them on.

You will partner with our Billing Infrastructure and Growth & Enablement engineering teams and with Security, and work closely with Finance, FP&A, RevOps, Support, Sales and our Growth PMs.

Success in this role looks like a clean move to Stripe, an identity platform that is simple for customers and safe for the business, and core services the rest of the company can build on without waiting on you.

The ideal candidate has real depth in how money moves through a subscription business, is technical enough to shape engineering decisions, and has the range to take on platform problems well beyond billing.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* **Lead the Definition of Core Services:** Set the vision and multi-year roadmap for the shared services every product depends on, starting with billing and identity. Define how each service should behave, what we build, in what order and why. Engineering owns delivery; you own what "done" means and whether we have met it.
* **Own Billing & Payments Strategy:** Set direction for subscriptions, plans and pricing, invoicing, payment methods, payment recovery, refunds and account changes. Decide the sequence and make the trade-offs explicit.
* **Finish** **the Move to Stripe:** Define the phasing, success metrics, acceptance criteria and sign-off bar for our migration from an in-house billing system to Stripe Billing. Set the testing, rollback and control expectations from day one. Every customer should come through without noticing.
* **Make Pricing Changes Simple and Fast:** Make price changes, new plans and add-ons quick and easy to launch. Define how what a customer pays for maps to what the product lets them do, so pricing, packaging and access stay in step across products.
* **Own Identity & Authentication:** Set the direction for sign-in, single sign-on (SSO), account access and the identity platform behind them, with Engineering and Security. Define the account, role and permission model that our products and partners build on.
* **Make Billing Data Trustworthy:** Define the billing data model and the source of truth across our systems so Finance's reporting, revenue recognition and audits reconcile without manual work. You define how the data should look; Finance and our data team own the reporting built on it.
* **Lead Across Stakeholders:** Be the product lead for Finance, FP&A, RevOps, Support and Sales on billing and identity. Set priorities across them, explain trade-offs clearly and build alignment around the plan.
* **Take On What Comes Next:** As billing and identity settle, extend the same approach to other core services the business needs, whether that is entitlements, account structure, partner billing or something we have not named yet.
* **Raise the Bar:** Mentor other product managers and help set how product works across platform teams.

**Who You Are**
---------------

* **An Experienced Platform Product Leader:** You have 8+ years of Product Management experience in SaaS, with at least 4 years owning billing, payments or subscription commerce, and you have operated at a Staff or Principal level on a platform or core service that other product teams build on.
* **Fluent in Billing & Payments:** You know subscriptions, trials, upgrades and downgrades, proration, payment recovery, refunds, chargebacks, multi-currency and tax. You have worked with Stripe or a comparable platform such as Zuora, Chargebee, Recurly or Adyen, and you understand how these platforms work under the hood.
* **Conversant in Identity:** You understand authentication and authorization, SSO, multi-factor authentication, and role and permission models well enough to set direction and ask the right questions. You do not need to have owned an identity platform before, but you need to be able to lead one.
* **Technically Credible:** You can read an API spec and follow data across systems. You ask sharp questions about webhooks, retries, source of truth and rollback plans. You can write SQL to check a number yourself. Engineers value your judgment, and you engage confidently on estimates and design.
* **Strategic and Opinionated:** You bring a point of view on what we should build and why. You think in services, not features: when a dozen teams ask for a dozen things, you see the one capability underneath. You think in quarters and years, bring clarity to ambiguous problems, and can guide senior stakeholders toward the right sequence while keeping their trust.
* **Rigorous and Detail-Oriented:** You have shipped a migration, cutover or pricing change with real customer and revenue stakes. You plan testing, rollback and controls from the start.
* **A Clear Communicator:** You can explain a billing or access trade-off to an executive, a support agent and an engineer, and each of them gets it.
* **AI-Native and Curious:** You already use AI tools to research, analyze data and move faster. It is part of how you work today.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Led a migration from an in-house or legacy billing system to Stripe or another modern platform.
* Owned an identity or access platform: Okta, OAuth, OpenID Connect, SAML, SSO, multi-factor authentication or role-based access control.
* Experience with entitlement, packaging or feature-access systems that connect what a customer pays for to what they can do.
* Experience in a high-volume, self-serve SMB subscription business.
* Partner or reseller billing, where a third party bills the customer.
* Finance systems experience: ERP, CPQ, revenue recognition or SOX controls.
* Experience on a platform team that serves multiple product groups.
* Experience mentoring senior PMs.

**How We Work**
---------------

* We own outcomes.
* We plan for the medium and long term and focus on what matters most.
* We hold a high bar for billing accuracy.
* We build in testing, rollback and controls from day one.
* We solve problems at the root.
* We use AI tools to move faster and see more clearly.
* We give people autonomy and trust their judgment.

Process Improvement and Strategic Contribution

OpenTable is looking for an Associate Manager, Accounting to own a highly technical portfolio spanning partnership revenue, loyalty, and leases, along with other technical areas such as bad debt, prepaids, and accruals, and the close-related operations that support them. This role reports to the Manager, Accounting. This posting is for an existing vacancy.

**Responsibilities**

* Own the end-to-end accounting for fast-growing strategic partnership revenue programs, managing complex models to support revenue and expense recognition and balance sheet treatment
* Own the technical accounting for the evolving loyalty program, using judgment to evaluate the key assumptions that drive it
* Lead the accounting across other technical areas including leases, bad debt, prepaids, and accruals, spanning multiple OpenTable legal entities, all reported under US GAAP

description:
**Job Description:** Director Trade Marketing (LDB)
  
**Job Title:** Director, Trade Marketing
  
**Division:** L’Oréal Dermatological Beauty (LDB)
  
**Reports To:** AVP, Trade Marketing
  
  
**Location:** Hudson Yards, NY
  
  
Who We Are
  
  
The Trade Marketing team at L’Oréal Dermatological Beauty (LDB) operates as the critical commercial engine and strategic bridge between our world-class brands—CeraVe, La Roche-Posay, and Vichy—and our retail partners. We do not simply execute plans; we are the architects of the commercial strategy. We translate high-level national brand visions into concrete, localized, and winning trade architectures that dictate how our portfolio dominates at the shelf and on the screen.
  
  
We are looking for a powerhouse leader to step into the role of AVP, Trade Marketing. This is not a role for those who seek the path of least resistance. It is a high-visibility, high-stakes position that requires an individual with exceptional grit, an unshakeable work ethic, and a commanding professional presence. You will lead the charge in bridging marketing ambition with commercial reality, serving as a highly reliable, deeply trusted partner to both internal teams and retail giants.
  
  
The Opportunity & Your Impact
  
  
As the AVP of Trade Marketing, you will lead a high-performing team tasked with translating each brand's national strategy and defining the overarching commercial strategy for the division. You will be the ultimate owner of how CeraVe, La Roche-Posay, and Vichy show up commercially, establishing the promotional guardrails, trade spending efficiency parameters, and go-to-market execution plans.
  
  
This role demands a leader who is not afraid to go toe-to-toe with General Managers, Brand Presidents, and Marketing heads. You will be the voice of commercial reality, backed by bulletproof, data-driven analytics. When tough conversations are needed regarding how national strategies must adapt to the retail landscape, or when commercial parameters must be strictly defined, you will lean in with confidence, facts, and a solution-oriented attitude.
  
  
**What We’re Looking For:** Our Future Leader
  
  
We are searching for a relentless driver who brings a masterclass balance of strategic marketing translation, commercial street-smarts, and analytic rigor. You are someone who:
  

* Is a Strategic Translator: You can look at a national brand marketing plan and immediately identify how to operationalize it into a commercial strategy that retailers buy into.
* Possesses Deep Grit: You roll up your sleeves, thrive in fast-paced complexity, and view obstacles as puzzles to be solved. You are resilient, reliable, and run toward challenges, not away from them.
* Commands the Room: You have a strong, authentic leadership style and an executive presence that immediately builds trust.
* Engages in Constructive Friction: You are comfortable speaking truth to power. You are fearless in challenging GMs, Sales leaders, and Marketers to ensure our trade strategies are both commercially sound and highly profitable.
* Is Rooted in Data: Your opinions are strong, but they are always backed by objective, meticulous analytics. You are a trusted source of truth because you let the data do the heavy lifting.

Key Job Responsibilities
  

* Define Commercial Strategy for one of our two mass brands: Serve as the chief architect in translating brand-specific national strategies into a unified, high-performing divisional commercial strategy across all key retail channels.
* Translate National Brand Ambition: Act as the strategic conduit between Brand Marketing and Sales. Take national campaigns and product launches and translate them into commercially viable retail programs for CeraVe, La Roche-Posay, and Vichy.
* Commercial Guardrail Ownership: Establish and enforce rigorous divisional trade guidelines. Collaborate cross-functionally (Divisional Leadership, Sales, Marketing, and Finance) to align brand ambitions with commercial realities and strict ROI parameters.
* Fearless Stakeholder Management: Act as the strategic partner and challenger to GMs and Brand Teams. Drive the tough, necessary alignments on promotional ROI, pricing executions, and commercial trade spend when national strategies clash with field realities.
* Bulletproof Analytical Storytelling: Translate complex retailer, consumer, and financial data into clear, persuasive strategic narratives. Deliver high-impact presentations to executive leadership.
* Team Leadership & Capability Building: Lead, mentor, and inspire a high-performing Trade Marketing team, fostering a culture of high performance, accountability, and continuous development.
* P&L and ROI Optimization: Maintain a deep, precise understanding of the divisional P&L. Rigorously analyze promotional ROI and trade spend efficiency to identify and capture profit-improvement opportunities.
* Retailer & Field Collaboration: Work hand-in-hand with Field Sales and Customer Marketing to ensure our defined commercial plans are flawlessly executed, highly competitive, and customized to win across the retailer landscape.

Background & Experience Requirements
  
  
**Educational Background:**  

* Bachelor’s degree in Sales, Commercial Strategy, Marketing, Commercial Finance, Data Analytics, Economics, or a related business field. MBA is a plus.

**Professional Experience & Technical Skills:**  

* 7-12+ years of experience working in a fast-paced FMCG or CPG organization, with a strong preference for deep exposure to Trade Marketing, Commercial Strategy, or Category Management.
* Experienced managerial skills with multiple direct reports and upscaling junior talent
* Strategic Translation Track Record: Proven experience taking high-level brand ideas/national strategies and successfully mapping them into commercial, retailer-facing programs.
* Proven Leadership: A track record of leading teams and directly influencing senior, multi-functional leadership.
* Commercial Acumen: A deep understanding of the US retailer landscape, trade spend mechanics, and how brand marketing strategies translate to the retail shelf.
* Financial Literacy: Strong command of product financial structures and P&L dynamics; capability to evaluate the financial health of trade investments.
* Analytical Rigor: Hands-on experience working with large, complex datasets to derive actionable insights. Familiarity with syndicated data sources (Circana/IRI, Numerator, Nielsen) and trade promotion management tools.
* Technical Proficiency: High comfort level with data visualization and analytics tools (Advanced Excel, Power BI, Tableau) to build data-backed arguments.

**Salary range:** $138K-$200K

The Senior Data Analyst will be responsible for supporting data management and analyses using clinical, administrative, and operational data, and for planning, designing, and implementing statistical analyses. This will include working with large national and multicenter research network databases, including electronic health record (EHR) and claims data. The individual in this position will support multiple projects in day-to-day activities, including preliminary data analysis, data visualization, predictive and machine learning analytics, causal inference analyses, and results dissemination. All research and programming code must be regularly documented and archived per best practices. Other responsibilities will include coordinating and participating in regular meetings that pertain to data preparation, management, analyses and ongoing research projects. The analyst will communicate information and data in written and verbal form to colleagues as well as project and senior management teams. A successful applicant will be a strong communicator, be curious, inquisitive and resourceful, have a high degree of professional maturity and commitment to excellence, and be able to work autonomously and comfortably on a health services research team in an academic medical center environment.

**Job Responsibilities:**

Demonstrates knowledge of the organizations Core Values and incorporates them into the performance of duties.

Ensures that data are compiled, analyzed, and presented appropriately, and performs reviews to ensure data accuracy and completeness.  
Ensures compliance with HIPAA, IRB protocols, and data use agreements.

title: Procurement Intelligence Analyst
description:
The Procurement Intelligence Analyst develops and delivers the analytics, market intelligence, performance reporting, and data insights that enable Enterprise Procurement to make informed, data-driven decisions. The role transforms procurement, supplier, financial, and operational data into actionable insights supporting category strategy, sourcing, Vendor Management, value realization, risk governance, and executive decision-making. Working collaboratively with Category Management, Vendor Management, Procurement Operations Hub, Finance, the Procurement Center of Excellence (COE), and business stakeholders, the role establishes trusted procurement reporting, spend visibility, supplier and vendor performance analytics, savings measurement, and market intelligence. The Procurement Intelligence Analyst also partners with the Procurement Digital Transformation Lead to advance automated reporting, AI-enabled analytics, and predictive insights as the organization builds a more digitally enabled procurement operating model.

**Duties & Responsibilities**

**Procurement Analytics, Performance & Executive Reporting**

* Develop, maintain, and continuously improve enterprise procurement dashboards, performance reports, and executive reporting that provide visibility into procurement value, operational performance, supplier performance, and strategic priorities.
* Establish and monitor procurement KPIs including savings and value realization, spend coverage, contract compliance, supplier performance, sourcing activity, cycle times, process efficiency, and stakeholder experience.
* Translate complex procurement data into clear insights, trends, and recommendations that support Procurement Leadership Team and executive decision-making.
* Produce recurring and ad hoc reporting for procurement leadership, governance forums, category reviews, Vendor Management reviews, and enterprise stakeholders.
* Ensure procurement reporting is accurate, timely, consistent, and supported by clearly defined metrics and trusted data sources.

**Spend, Category & Market Intelligence**

* Analyze enterprise spend across categories, suppliers, business units, and service areas to identify sourcing opportunities, demand trends, supplier concentration, and cost optimization opportunities.
* Develop category and supplier intelligence that supports category strategies, sourcing pipelines, negotiations, demand planning, and total cost of ownership analyses.
* Conduct market research and benchmarking across supplier markets, pricing trends, economic indicators, industry developments, and emerging technologies.
* Partner with Category Management to provide fact-based analytical support for category planning, supplier landscape assessments, business cases, and commercial recommendations.
* Maintain enterprise spend visibility and continuously improve spend classification, segmentation, and analytical usability.

**Supplier & Vendor Performance Intelligence**

* Develop and maintain supplier and vendor performance reporting, scorecards, and analytical views in support of Vendor Management and Category Management.
* Aggregate and analyze SLA, KPI, risk, issue, financial, and operational performance data to identify performance trends, emerging risks, and improvement opportunities.
* Provide analytical support for QBRs, executive business reviews, vendor governance meetings, supplier segmentation, and strategic account planning.
* Partner with Vendor Leads and business stakeholders to improve scorecard consistency, performance transparency, and actionable supplier insights.
* Support development of automated scorecards, alerts, dashboards, and reporting capabilities in partnership with the Procurement Digital Transformation Lead.

**Savings, Value Realization & Financial Insights**

* Develop and maintain enterprise methodologies, reporting, and controls for procurement savings, cost avoidance, and value realization.
* Track sourcing and category initiatives against approved value targets and provide transparent reporting on pipeline, realized value, and performance to plan.
* Partner with Finance and Category Management to validate savings methodologies, assumptions, baselines, and realized financial outcomes.
* Analyze procurement performance against annual targets and identify risks, gaps, and opportunities requiring leadership attention.
* Develop financial models, supplier comparisons, scenario analyses, and commercial evaluations supporting sourcing and procurement decisions.

**Data Governance, Digital Analytics & AI Enablement**

* Establish and maintain procurement data definitions, reporting standards, quality controls, and governance practices that improve consistency and trust in procurement information.
* Partner with Information Technology, Finance, Procurement Operations Hub, and system owners to improve procurement data architecture, source-system integration, and reporting reliability.
* Partner with the Procurement Digital Transformation Lead to automate procurement reporting, develop AI-enabled insights, and expand predictive and self-service analytics capabilities.
* Support analytics and reporting requirements for digital procurement, Vendor Management, Source-to-Pay automation, and digital workforce initiatives.
* Evaluate emerging analytics technologies, data visualization methods, and AI capabilities that improve procurement intelligence and decision support.

**Business Partnership & Continuous Improvement**

Reporting to the Director of Strategic Intelligence and Pipeline, the Pipeline Intelligence Analyst is responsible for maintaining a trusted enterprise pipeline and producing the analysis required to manage growth performance, opportunity priorities and portfolio risk.

**Pipeline Reporting & Dashboards**
-----------------------------------

* Analyze pipeline balance across sectors, commissioners, territories, service lines and maturity stages.
* Identify concentration, diversification and coverage trends within the opportunity portfolio.

description:
**About ASCAP**

The American Society of Composers, Authors and Publishers (ASCAP) is a membership association of more than one million songwriters, composers and music publishers, and represents some of the world’s most talented music creators. Founded and governed by songwriters, composers and publishers, it is the only performing rights organization in the U.S. that operates on a not-for-profit basis. ASCAP licenses a repertory of over 20 million musical works to hundreds of thousands of businesses that use music, including streaming services, cable television, radio and satellite radio and brick and mortar businesses such as retail stores, hotels, clubs, restaurants and bars. ASCAP collects the licensing fees; identifies, matches and processes trillions of performances every year; and returns nearly 90 cents of every dollar back to its members as royalties. The ASCAP blanket license offers an efficient solution for businesses to legally perform ASCAP music while respecting the right of songwriters and composers to be paid fairly. ASCAP puts music creators first, advocating for their rights and the value of music on Capitol Hill, driving innovation that moves the industry forward, building community and providing the resources and support that creators need to succeed in their careers. Learn more and stay in touch at www.ascap.com, on X and Instagram @ASCAP and on Facebook.

# # #

**Job Overview:**

The TV Analyst is responsible for assisting both the TV Team Leader and other TV Distribution team members with the processing of audio and visual programming, sharing in the overall responsibility of ensuring that ASCAP members are properly credited for the performance of their works in audio/visual media.

Successful completion of these efforts requires the careful analysis of television performance, promo, and cue sheet data. TV Analysts will associate programs and promos with performances, verify the accuracy of any data provided, procure and upload any missing data, identify and reconcile discrepancies, and participate in quality assurance procedures to ensure that ASCAP members are accurately paid. The TV Analyst position reports to the TV Team Leader, is situated within the TV Distribution department, and is based out of ASCAP’s New York City office. This is a hybrid position with currently a minimum 1 day per week in-office requirement.

**Areas of Responsibility & Accountability:**

* Identify and match cue sheets to performances.
* Request missing or incomplete cue sheets from suppliers.
* Upload missing performances to the performance database.
* Reconcile the station count and any informational discrepancies within performance data.
* Verify cue sheet content.
* Assign and create work records for cues.
* Control check work records and performances that have been matched by 3rd party vendors.
* Integrate music video programming into distribution.
* Assist with the timely resolution of member-initiated inquiries.

The PGIM Strategy team supports the CEO of PGIM and the whole leadership team in developing and executing strategy around the business’ most critical priorities. The Strategy team works on a wide variety of projects including competitor analysis, market evaluation and entry, and mergers and acquisitions. The Strategy Senior Analyst/Associate role is the ideal opportunity for an ambitious and talented candidate to work in a collegial and high performing team, and build experience working in the asset management industry directly supporting senior business leaders.

As an Senior Analyst, you will be part of a small strategy team overseen by the Chief Strategy Officer. You will be given high levels of responsibility across multiple projects, and asked to tackle complex business challenges from day one.

**THE POSITION**

Our roster has an opening with your name on it

FanDuel is looking for a **Basketball Pricing Analyst (Sports Trader)** to join our **Trading Team**, helping to shape the odds and betting markets that customers engage with. We're looking for someone with a passion for NBA and also ideally WNBA.

Whether you have a numbers background, have studied analytics, worked in sports, or are just obsessed with Basketball, we'd love to support your growth into a trading role. No prior trading or gambling experience is required.

This is a hybrid position with office presence required in Jersey City, NJ (just across the river from Manhattan). In this role, expect to be predominantly in-office for hands-on training and core Trading tasks. The office contains an open space with a hot-desk environment. Each station has multiple monitors and there are TVs and constant noise in the office. You'll also work regular late shifts (typically 2:30pm–10:30pm ET), which will include assisting the team with live betting. This role requires weekend work.

In addition to the specific responsibilities outlined below, employees may occasionally be asked to support other duties in line with evolving business needs and their preferences.

  

**THE GAME PLAN**
  
Everyone on our team has a part to play

As a Sports Trader, you'll start by learning the core skills that power our odds and markets. You'll receive hands-on training in how sports betting works, how we use models and data to manage prices, and how we monitor news and customer behavior to keep our pricing sharp.

Your day-to-day will include:

* Learning to set and manage prices on basketball games, player stats, and futures markets — from pre-game to live in-play odds — using our in-house tools and models.
* Monitoring real-time news, stats, and industry pricing to help guide trading decisions.
* Trading live games in real time; making quick adjustments to pricing based on game flow, key events, and customer behavior.
* Collaborating with other Traders and working cross-functionally with other teams within the Risk & Trading department or across the wider FanDuel business, in a cooperative and inclusive environment.
* Helping brainstorm new products or ways to improve the customer experience, with consideration for how fans engage with the game.

You'll work alongside experienced Traders who will guide your development. Over time, you'll gain the confidence and expertise to price markets independently, manage risk, and shape the sports betting experience for our customers.

* A deep passion for NBA or WNBA (more than one league is a plus)

The company is based in New York with US offices in Los Angeles, Atlanta, and Jersey City, as well as global offices in Canada and Scotland. The company's affiliates have offices worldwide, including in Ireland, Portugal, Romania, and Australia.

Oscar is hiring a Technical Program Manager to join our Tech PMO, dedicated to a major enterprise data transformation. You'll partner closely with Data leadership to lead migration from planning through delivery, protecting the quality and integrity of the data our teams rely on every day.

We're looking for someone who has experience partnering with Data teams and leading a major enterprise data migration and who brings curiosity, initiative, and sound judgment. You'll have the opportunity to shape how Oscar delivers enterprise data programs and help build a strong TPM team. This is an individual contributor role reporting to the Director of the Tech PMO, partnering closely with Data leadership. You'll lead technical program execution, with Data Engineering accountable for architecture and implementation.

You will report into the Director, Technical Program Management.

**Pay Transparency:** The base pay for this role is: $117,576 - $154,319 per year. You are also eligible for employee benefits, participation in Oscar's unlimited vacation program, and annual performance bonuses.

  

**Responsibilities:**

* Own the integrated enterprise data migration plan from scoping through delivery and operational handoff, with clear owners, migration waves, milestones, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.

* 5+ years of technical program or project management/process-oriented operations work experience.
* 2+ years of experience using coding languages such as SQL to analyze project performance and risks and develop erports for management and business owners.
* Experience independently leading complex software development programs across multiple teams, from planning through launch and operational handoff.
* Technical fluency in data pipelines, transformation layers, data models, semantic layers, lineage, and integrations, with the judgment to challenge migration plans, validation approaches, and implementation tradeoffs.
* Demonstrated ability to structure ambiguous enterprise programs, manage cross-domain dependencies and competing priorities, and coordinate data validation, cutover readiness, and business continuity.

title: Chief Operating Officer
description:
***To be considered for this role, please call 866-996-6549 and follow the step-by-step instructions outlined by our Co-Founder and Managing Partner. In addition, please complete your application here. You will be evaluated and vetted based on your ability to follow instructions. We look forward to hearing from you!***

**About the role**
==================

We started Chaffin Luhana in January 2010 because we wanted to build a firm where our actions match our values. Since then, our attorneys have recovered more than $1 billion for injured people, and state and federal judges have appointed us to lead national product liability litigation. Our ethos is Doing Good by Doing Right™.  
We are looking for a full-time COO to join us as the senior-most business leader in the firm. We run on EOS, and you will serve as our Integrator, reporting directly to the two founding partners.  
Here is the honest context. We built this firm’s operations ourselves, and the firm has outgrown the way we built them. We have strong department leaders, a growing brand, and some very good years in front of us. What we don't have is one person who is fully engaged in driving the business forward: someone who identifies the priorities, brings us recommendations, and gets the team executing without either founder having to keep pushing things along (or getting in the way). Everything else in this description is detail. That is the job.  
  
**Why Be the COO at Chaffin Luhana?**  
**Run the business.** You will run the whole business, not a slice of it. Marketing, intake, client experience, finance, people, and technology all report through this seat, and you will work directly with the two founders on where the firm goes next.  
**Help shape what comes next.** AI, management services organizations (MSOs), and changing client expectations are creating new choices for law firms. Help us evaluate those choices and remain competitive while staying true to our ethos. We want your judgment about where to invest, what to change, and what to protect.  
**The timing is genuinely good.** We have significant litigation maturing over the next few years and the resources to invest ahead of it. This is a role for a growing firm that needs a real operator at the wheel.  
**You will build, not maintain.** Our reporting and analytics are partially built, and finishing that work is yours to own and design. A year from now, the way this firm makes decisions should reflect how you decided it should work.  
**The mission is real.** We describe ourselves as data driven but heart led. Our clients come to us during the darkest time in their lives, and we believe one of our strongest differentiators is the compassion we have across the team. We hire by our values, promote by them, and have parted ways with talented people over them.  
**We have staying power.** Mass torts and contingency work run on long business cycles, and plenty of firms don't last. We've been doing this for fifteen years, we've grown through the hard parts, and it's been worth the push.  
**Help people become their best.** We want our team members to grow professionally and personally, become exceptional colleagues and leaders, and give clients an incredible experience. Strong operations should help our attorneys and team deliver outstanding litigation and trial results. Compassion, high standards, and accountability belong together here.

**The authority to lead**
=========================

Once you understand the business and have established an operating plan with the founders, you will have authority to allocate the approved budget, make hiring and firing decisions, change leadership when needed, and direct marketing execution. We expect you to use that authority and develop leaders who own their responsibilities.  
You will work with the founders on firm strategy and major investments, keeping us informed about performance and significant decisions. We welcome thoughtful challenge, clear recommendations, and sound judgment. Attorneys retain responsibility for legal judgment and litigation strategy.  
  
**What you will own**

**Priorities and execution**
============================

Translate the partners’ vision into the annual plan and quarterly Rocks. Bring your recommendation on what matters most, identify capacity constraints, and keep the firm focused—including telling the founders when we are adding too much.  
Run leadership meetings that end in decisions, owners, and deadlines. Make sure the work gets done between meetings and that department leaders take responsibility for results.

**Business reporting and analytics**
====================================

Complete the reporting buildout with Finance and Technology: consistent KPI definitions, reliable data, named owners, and dashboards leaders actually use. Determine the expertise needed, whether an analyst hire or outside support, and drive the work to completion. This is a core first-year deliverable.  
Understand the numbers well enough to challenge assumptions, explain what is changing, and recommend action. Connect marketing, intake, case inventory, staffing, and financial information.

**Marketing and intake**
========================

Own case acquisition economics end to end: spend, lead quality, conversion, cost per qualified signed case, and expected case value by market, practice area, and channel. Hold Marketing and Intake leaders accountable for both case quality and signed-case targets.  
Pressure-test changes in spending and strategy. Watch leading indicators and act before a shortfall becomes a revenue problem, accounting for different PI and mass tort timelines. Assess whether the right people are in the right seats and make changes when needed.

**Financial visibility**
========================

Partner with Finance on the operating budget, compensation and staffing models, forecasting, and monthly variance reviews. Resolve variances with the responsible department leaders.  
Maintain a rolling view of cash and case inventory that connects expected fee timing to spending and hiring decisions. Make assumptions and uncertainty visible, and distinguish operating performance from the timing of individual case recoveries.

**Client experience and innovation**
====================================

Take ownership of implementing our client journey vision. Set priorities, assign owners, and turn ideas into measurable improvements from intake through resolution. Work with legal leaders to remove operational barriers to case progress, settlement, and trial readiness.  
Evaluate technology, AI, and process changes through focused pilots. Measure whether they improve client service or team effectiveness, protect confidential information, and ensure successful changes become part of everyday work.

**Leadership and people**
=========================

Lead department heads, address missed commitments directly, and develop managers who solve problems at their own level. Partner with People Services on hiring, onboarding, development, and performance management.  
Create an environment where people are supported and challenged to grow, and where compassion and candor reinforce high expectations. Bring significant issues to the partners promptly, with recommendations whenever possible.

**First 90 days.** Assess leadership, reporting, acquisition economics, and client-experience priorities. Agree with the founders on the operating plan, resources, decision boundaries, and measurable targets while addressing urgent issues.

description:
**Who We Are**

Join a team that puts its People First! First American's Direct division provides comprehensive title insurance protection and professional settlement services for real estate purchases, refinances and equity loans. Since 1889, First American (NYSE: FAF) has held an unwavering belief in its people. They are passionate about what they do, and we are equally passionate about fostering an environment where all feel welcome, supported, and empowered to be innovative and reach their full potential. Our inclusive, people-first culture has earned our company numerous accolades, including being named to the Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For® list for eleven consecutive years. We have also earned awards as a best place to work for women, diversity and LGBTQ+ employees, and have been included on more than 50 regional best places to work lists. First American will always strive to be a great place to work, for all. For more information, please visit www.careers.firstam.com.

**What We Do**
==============

Envelope is a property analytics and zoning technology platform that uses zoning regulations and property data to visualize and evaluate the development potential of a site. The platform helps translate complex zoning requirements into actionable property and development insights. The Senior Zoning Analyst is responsible for performing advanced zoning research and analysis, with a primary focus on interpreting New York City zoning regulations and evaluating their application to real property within the proprietary Envelope platform.  
  
Serves as a subject matter resource on complex zoning matters and regulatory changes. Translates zoning requirements into structured logic and product requirements, validates technology-generated zoning analyses through manual testing, and prepares client-ready zoning analyses.  
  
Partners with product, engineering, GIS/data, and business teams to support the accuracy and continued development of Envelope and related zoning products.  
  
Works with sales reps to present and market the product when a more advanced subject matter expert is needed.

**What You’ll Do**

* Research and interpret NYC zoning regulations, maps, amendments, resolutions, and other applicable land-use requirements.
* Analyze development standards, including permitted uses, FAR, bulk, height and setback, yards, lot coverage, density, parking, special districts, overlays, and applicable bonuses.
* Monitor regulatory changes and assess their impact on properties, zoning analyses, product logic, data, and internal processes.
* Serve as a subject matter resource on complex or ambiguous zoning provisions.
* Perform zoning feasibility and baseline site analyses to test and validate Envelope outputs against applicable regulations, property data, and manual calculations.
* Provide guidance and technical support to less experienced zoning analysts on complex zoning research and interpretation.
* Translate complex zoning provisions into clear rules, calculations, and step-by-step logic for use within Envelope and related products.
* Partner with product, engineering, GIS/data, and business teams to translate zoning requirements into business, data, and product requirements.
* Communicate complex zoning requirements and findings to clients and internal stakeholders.
* Participate as needed in client meetings, product demonstrations, training, and presentations.

**What You’ll Bring**

**Knowledge and Skills**

* Familiarity with New York City zoning regulations, including the NYC Zoning Resolution and zoning maps.
* Strong understanding of zoning concepts such as FAR, permitted uses, bulk and dimensional requirements, height and setback regulations, density, special districts, overlays, and other development controls.
* Demonstrated ability to break down complex, text-based regulations into clear, structured rules, calculations, and logical requirements.
* Strong ability to independently evaluate zoning code changes and determine their practical impact on properties, analyses, processes, data, and products.
* Strong quality-control and technical-review skills, including the ability to manually validate technology-generated zoning analyses.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex zoning concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Strong project coordination and organizational skills.
* Experience working with cross-functional teams, including technology, product, engineering, operations, GIS/data, and client-facing teams.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.
* Familiarity with NYC property and planning data sources and mapping tools, such as PLUTO/MapPLUTO and ZoLa, preferred.
* Experience with GIS or mapping software, such as ArcGIS or QGIS, preferred.
* Familiarity with architectural or development analysis tools, such as AutoCAD or Rhino, is a plus.

**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in urban planning, real estate, architecture, land use, geography, or a related field required.
* 5+ years of directly related zoning, land-use, planning, real estate, or regulatory analysis experience.
* Demonstrated experience independently researching and interpreting zoning regulations required.
* Experience reviewing zoning code amendments and regulatory changes and determining their impact strongly preferred.
* Experience with New York City zoning regulations, the NYC Zoning Resolution, and land-use requirements strongly preferred.
* Experience performing zoning feasibility, development potential, or site analysis preferred.
* Experience working with zoning, GIS, property-data, or real estate technology platforms preferred.

title: Pizza Inventory Analyst
description:
Job Summary

Northern Fires Pizza is seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Pizza Inventory Analyst to monitor stock levels, analyze ingredient usage, maintain inventory records, and support efficient supply management. This role helps ensure that pizza ingredients, packaging materials, and restaurant supplies are available when needed while minimizing waste, preventing shortages, and supporting cost control.

The ideal candidate has strong analytical and organizational skills, enjoys working with inventory data, and can collaborate with kitchen staff, purchasing personnel, suppliers, and restaurant management.

Key Responsibilities

* Monitor inventory levels for pizza ingredients, including flour, cheese, tomato sauce, vegetables, meats, and specialty toppings.
* Analyze inventory usage patterns to identify trends, potential shortages, and excess stock.
* Maintain accurate inventory records, including deliveries, stock movements, adjustments, and consumption.
* Conduct regular inventory counts and reconcile physical quantities with inventory system records.
* Assist with forecasting ingredient requirements based on sales trends and operational demand.
* Review stock replenishment needs and communicate purchasing recommendations to management.
* Track expiration dates and support first-in, first-out (FIFO) inventory rotation.
* Investigate inventory discrepancies and recommend corrective actions.
* Analyze food waste, spoilage, and product usage to identify cost-saving opportunities.
* Monitor packaging materials, beverages, cleaning supplies, and other restaurant necessities.
* Coordinate with kitchen staff to understand ingredient requirements and changing menu demands.
* Review supplier delivery records and report missing, damaged, or incorrect items.
* Prepare inventory summaries, spreadsheets, and performance reports for management.
* Support purchasing decisions through stock analysis and historical usage data.
* Follow applicable food safety, storage, sanitation, and inventory control procedures.

Qualifications and Requirements

* High school diploma or equivalent required; additional education in business, accounting, data analysis, or supply chain management is an advantage.
* Previous experience in inventory analysis, stock control, purchasing, or restaurant operations preferred.
* Strong numerical, analytical, and organizational skills.
* Proficiency with spreadsheets and basic inventory management systems.
* Excellent attention to detail and recordkeeping accuracy.
* Ability to interpret inventory data and identify unusual patterns.
* Strong communication and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet reporting deadlines.
* Familiarity with food storage practices, expiration monitoring, and stock rotation is beneficial.
* Ability to work collaboratively with restaurant teams and suppliers.

Preferred Skills

* Inventory forecasting and demand planning.
* Stock reconciliation and discrepancy investigation.
* Spreadsheet analysis and reporting.
* Food cost monitoring and waste reduction.
* Purchasing support and replenishment planning.
* Data entry and inventory documentation.
* Time management and critical thinking.
* Knowledge of restaurant supply operations.

Work Environment

The Pizza Inventory Analyst works in a restaurant operations environment, coordinating with kitchen personnel, purchasing teams, suppliers, and management. The position combines computer-based reporting and inventory analysis with occasional physical stock counts and delivery verification. The successful candidate must maintain accurate records and adapt to changing inventory needs during busy service periods.

Benefits

Depending on company policy, employment status, and eligibility, benefits may include:

* Competitive compensation.
* Employee meal discounts.
* Paid time off.
* On-the-job training and professional development.
* Opportunities to strengthen analytical and inventory management skills.
* Potential advancement into inventory management, procurement analysis, or restaurant operations.

About the Company

Northern Fires Pizza is identified here as a pizza-focused food service business for this job-posting draft. The Pizza Inventory Analyst supports daily operations by monitoring ingredient availability, maintaining accurate stock records, and identifying opportunities to improve inventory efficiency. Specific company information and employment policies should be confirmed with the hiring organization.

How to Apply

Interested candidates should submit a resume highlighting relevant experience in inventory analysis, data entry, stock control, purchasing, or restaurant operations. Applicants should demonstrate analytical ability, attention to detail, and a commitment to accurate inventory reporting and efficient supply management.

**Employee Lifecycle Administration**

* Process client new-hire requests; prepare and distribute required onboarding information; follow up on outstanding items; and maintain accurate employee personnel files.
* Process client termination requests; prepare and distribute required termination information; complete follow-up activities; and maintain accurate employee files.
* Respond to and follow up on unemployment verification requests involving client employees.
* Review payroll activity to confirm that new hires, terminations, employee changes, leaves of absence, disability events, and related benefit changes are reflected accurately.

**Client and Employee Support**

* Respond to day-to-day benefit plan questions from Client Advisors (CAs), clients, and client employees.
* Research client, client employee, and CA inquiries and prepare clear summaries of findings and recommended next steps, as appropriate.

**HRA Administration**

* Administer client Health Reimbursement Arrangement (HRA) plans and maintain accurate eligibility and plan information.
* Remind eligible employees to submit HRA claims and assist with claim-submission issues.
* Perform quarterly HRA account reviews and analyze claims paid and account activity.
* Update HRA records for annual enrollment, plan design changes, new hires, and terminations.

**COBRA Administration**

* Administer stand-alone COBRA plans for assigned clients.
* Monitor COBRA participation and ensure records reflect plan design changes, new enrollments, terminations, coverage start dates, and coverage end dates.
* Coordinate and track required COBRA communications and follow-up items with vendors and affected participants.

**Benefit Plan Billing and Reconciliation**

* Process monthly invoices for client health plans, individual benefit plans, and FOM payroll vendors.
* Maintain billing tracking logs to confirm that invoices are current and paid on a timely basis.
* Reconcile medical and benefit invoices to payroll and employee headcount records; investigate and resolve discrepancies with carriers, providers, and vendors.

* Provide documentation and support for internal audits.

* Maintain complete, current, and accurate client and employee files daily.
* Review departmental processes and recommend improvements to enhance accuracy, efficiency, and service.

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* Minimum of five years of progressive human resources and/or employee benefits experience.
* Working knowledge of employee benefit administration and applicable compliance requirements.
* Demonstrate “generalist” understanding of HR with strong ability to source solutions to unique HR issues.
* Experience with leave administration and legal requirements around leaves at a federal and state level.
* Demonstrates an understanding of medical plan administration, HRA administration, and COBRA is a plus.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and client requests in a demanding environment.
* Strong people skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues, clients, employees, vendors, and carriers.
* Elevated level of accuracy, organization, discretion, and attention to detail.
* Strong interest in continuous learning of HR services for small group employer.
* Client-driven.
